content.description: If you are using a prepared HTML or text file for your e-mail template, the text appears here. You can enter the template text in this field instead of preparing the template file beforehand. If your template contains HTML, you must check the View as HTML box below to enter or paste in your template. You can also clear the View as HTML box below to enter and format text using the formatting options above. This eliminates the need for HTML code. If you select a file after entering text in this field, the template file overrides what is entered in this field.
content.title: Content

description.description: Enter a description for this email template. This description does not appear in the email you send with the template.
description.title: Description

isAutoConverted.description: This is selected if the template has been automatically converted from a different format.
isAutoConverted.title: Automatically Converted Template

isInactive.description: Check this box to inactivate this template. Inactive templates cannot be used to send email.
isInactive.title: Inactive

isPrivate.description: Check this box to make this template available only to you.
isPrivate.title: Private

name.description: Enter a name for this template. This name appears on the list of templates you select when sending an e-mail message to a contact.
name.title: Name

recordType.description: Entity – records relating to people or organizations such as company, contact, vendor, and employee records. e.g. most valuable customer emails, request for information replies, event invitations. Transaction - records containing or referring to financial exchanges between your business, customers, vendors etc. e.g. customer refund email, rebate information. Custom Record - any record type that you've created specifically for your business. e.g. warranty claims, new product feature updates. Case - records relating to Customer Service cases. e.g. requests for further information.
recordType.title: Record Type

scriptid.description: Type a script ID for this email template.
scriptid.title: ID

subject.description: Enter a default subject for e-mail generated by this template. You can edit the subject for individual e-mail messages or e-mail merge operations.
subject.title: Subject

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

accountNumber.description: If you, your payroll service, or other benefits provider assigns account numbers to your employees, enter that account number here. This field is required for the Online Bill Pay feature.
accountNumber.title: Account

aliennumber.description: Enter the employee's alien number. This is required only if the employee's work status is Alien authorized to work. The alien number is located in Section 1 of the completed I-9 form.
aliennumber.title: Alien Number

approvallimit.description: In the Expense Approval Limit field, enter the maximum amount this employee is allowed to approve on an expense report when specified as an approver for another employee. Expenses that exceed this amount must be approved by another supervisor or approver with a sufficient approval limit.
approvallimit.title: Expense Approval Limit

authworkdate.description: Enter the date through which the employee is authorized to work until. This is required only if the employee's work status is Alien authorized to work. This date is located in Section 1 of the completed I-9 form.
authworkdate.title: Work Authorization Expiry Date

autoName.description: Clear this box to manually enter an ID for this record. If you leave this box checked, NetSuite assigns an ID for this record based on your settings at Setup > Company > Auto-Generated Numbers.
autoName.title: Auto

birthdate.description: Enter the employee's date of birth.
birthdate.title: Birth Date

comments.description: Enter other information you want to track for this employee.
comments.title: Notes

concurrentwebservicesuser.description: A user type that allows concurrent web services access into NetSuite. Check this box to allow a user to have standard UI login access plus up to ten concurrent web services sessions.
concurrentwebservicesuser.title: Concurrent Web Services User

dateCreated.description: The date and time at which the Employee Record was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

defaultAddress.description: The employee's address. You can enter this information on the Address subtab, and it will appear here.
defaultAddress.title: Default Address

email.description: Enter your employee's email address. If you allow your employees to track time or enter expense reports online, this will become part of their access codes.
email.title: Email

entityId.description: If the Auto box is not checked, manually enter an ID for this record. If the Auto box is checked, NetSuite assigns an ID for this record based on your settings at Setup > Company > Auto-Generated Numbers.
entityId.title: Entity ID

expenselimit.description: In the Expense Limit field, enter the amount this employee can expense without approval from a supervisor or approver.
expenselimit.title: Expense Limit

externalId.description: Returns the employee's external ID, if one is assigned.
externalId.title: External ID

fax.description: Enter a fax number for this record. You should enter the fax number exactly as it must be dialed. If a '1' is required to fax to this number, be sure to include it at the beginning of the number. The number you enter here automatically appears in the To Be Faxed field of transactions when you select this employee. To fax NetSuite forms, an administrator must first set up fax service at Setup > Company > Printing, Fax & Email Preferences.
fax.title: Fax

firstName.description: Enter the employee's first name here. What you enter here automatically appears first in the Employee field. The first letter of what you enter here appears in the Initials field. This field is required for the Online Bill Pay feature.
firstName.title: First Name

giveAccess.description: Check this box to give your employee access to NetSuite. Then, assign a role to customize the level of access. You can assign multiple roles. To let your employee track time and enter expense reports, select the Employee Center role.
giveAccess.title: Login Access

hireDate.description: Enter the date this employee was hired.
hireDate.title: Hire Date

homePhone.description: Enter this employee's home phone number here.
homePhone.title: Home Phone

i9verified.description: Check this box if the employee has completed an I-9 form.
i9verified.title: I-9 Verified

initials.description: NetSuite automatically completes this field as you enter first, middle and last names. If you want to make changes to an employee's initials, enter up to three letters in this field.
initials.title: Initials

isInactive.description: Check this box to inactivate this employee record. Inactivated records no longer appear in lists or as choices anywhere in your account. To view inactivated employee records or reactivate them, go to Lists > Employees > Employees, and check the Show Inactives box.
isInactive.title: Is Inactive

issalesrep.description: Check this box to mark this employee as a sales representative. Sales representatives are listed in the sales rep dropdown list for sales order forms and for sales territory assignments.
issalesrep.title: Sales Rep

issupportrep.description: Check this box to mark this employee as a support representative. Support representatives are listed in the assigned to dropdown list for case forms and in the support rep dropdown list for support territory assignments.
issupportrep.title: Support Rep

jobdescription.description: Enter a description of the duties related to the job this person currently performs.
jobdescription.title: Job Description

lastModifiedDate.description: Returns the date on which the employee record was last modified.
lastModifiedDate.title: Last Modified Date

lastName.description: Enter the employee's last name here. What you enter here automatically appears last in the Employee field. The first letter of what you enter here appears in the Initials field. This field is required for the Online Bill Pay feature.
lastName.title: Last Name

lastReviewDate.description: Enter the date of this person's last salary evaluation.
lastReviewDate.title: Last Review Date

middleName.description: Enter a middle name or initial here. What you enter here automatically appears second in the Employee field. The first letter of what you enter here appears in the Initials field. Enter up to 25 characters in this field.
middleName.title: Middle Name

mobilePhone.description: Enter this employee's mobile or cell phone number here.
mobilePhone.title: Mobile Phone

nextReviewDate.description: Enter the date of this person's next salary evaluation.
nextReviewDate.title: Next Review Date

officePhone.description: Enter this employee's office phone number here.
officePhone.title: Office Phone

password.description: The Password and Confirm Password fields are only available if you checked the Manually Assign or Change Password box. Enter a password for the employee. As you type, the characters are validated against the password policy criteria, and the results displayed. You must tell the employee the password you assigned. Do not send the password by email. When you assign a password manually, you should also check the Require Password Change on Next Login box. For more information, see the help topic Password Requirements and Policies in NetSuite.
password.title: Password

password2.description: Re-enter the employee's password for verification. When you manually assign a password, you need to tell the employee the login information. Do not send the password by email.
password2.title: Confirm Password

phone.description: Enter a phone number for your employee. This field is required for Online Bill Pay enabled employees.
phone.title: Phone

purchaseorderapprovallimit.description: In the Purchase Approval Limit field, enter the maximum amount an employee is allowed to approve on a purchase request when specified as an approver for an employee.
purchaseorderapprovallimit.title: Purchase Approval Limit

purchaseorderlimit.description: In the Purchase Limit field, enter the amount this employee can purchase without approval from a supervisor or approver.
purchaseorderlimit.title: Purchase Limit

releasedate.description: Enter this person's last date of employment.
releasedate.title: Termination/Release Date

requirePwdChange.description: Check this box to require this user to change their password on their next login to NetSuite. When the user next logs in, they see the Change Password page and cannot access other NetSuite pages until a new password is created and saved. Requiring this action protects your account from unauthorized access using generic passwords and prepares your account for an audit. The Require Password Change on Next Login box never displays as checked. When you check this box and save the record, an internal flag is set. When the password change occurs, the flag is cleared. If you later check the box again and save the record, the internal flag is reset to require another password change.
requirePwdChange.title: Require Password Change On Next Login

salutation.description: Enter the employee's salutation, such as Mr. or Ms., here.
salutation.title: Mr./Ms...

sendEmail.description: Check this box to send an automatic email notifying this employee of access privileges to NetSuite. The standard NetSuite email message also contains a link to let the user create a password. If you do not check this box, you must check the Manually Assign or Change Password box. You must create the password, and tell the user the password, and when and how to log in. For security reasons, do not send the password by email.
sendEmail.title: Send New Access Notification Email

socialsecuritynumber.description: Enter this employee's social security number here in the following format: 123-45-6789.
socialsecuritynumber.title: Social Security Number

title.description: Enter this employee's official job title here.
title.title: Job Title

visaexpdate.description: Enter the expiration date of the employee's visa. This information can be obtained from the employee's passport.
visaexpdate.title: Visa Expiration Date

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

altSalesTotal.description: The alternate sales amount total is shown here.
altSalesTotal.title: Alt. Sales Total

billAddress.description: The default billing address autofills this field from the customer's record at Lists > Relationships > Customers. To enter a different address: * Select another address in the Bill To Select field. * Select New in the Bill To Select field to enter a new billing address.
billAddress.title: Bill To

discountRate.description: NetSuite enters the rate for the discount item you selected. You can change the discount rate for this cash refund. Enter the discount as a dollar amount like 10.00, or as a percentage like 10%.
discountRate.title: Rate

discountTotal.description: NetSuite enters the amount discounted on this estimate. If this discount item is taxable, the discount is applied before taxes. If it is not taxable, the discount is applied after taxes.
discountTotal.title: Discount Total

dueDate.description: Type or pick a date this estimate expires.
dueDate.title: Due Date

endDate.description: Enter or pick the end date for this estimate.
endDate.title: End Date

exchangeRate.description: The currency's exchange rate is shown in this field. You can edit the exchange rate for this transaction only, or you can update the currency record with the exchange rate you enter here.
exchangeRate.title: Exchange Rate

expectedCloseDate.description: Enter the date you expect this estimate to close.
expectedCloseDate.title: Expected Close Date

fob.description: Enter the location where the customers technically acquire ownership. For example, if your customers own goods as soon as they ship and pay the shipping costs from your location to theirs, you might enter Our warehouse.
fob.title: FOB

includeInForecast.description: Check this box to include this estimate in sales forecast reports, key performance indicators and snapshots. If this estimate has a probability below the min. probability you set at Setup > Set Up SFA > Forecasts, it will not appear on reports, key performance indicators and snapshots. If you use NetSuite or NetCRM and this estimate was created from an opportunity, checking this box removes the opportunity from the sales forecast. Clearing this box includes the opportunity instead.
includeInForecast.title: Include In Forecast

memo.description: If you wish, enter a memo to describe this estimate. It will appear on reports such as the 2-line Estimates register that your customers can see if you give them permission to log in and view their transaction history.
memo.title: Memo

message.description: The text of the customer message you select in the Select Message field appears here. You can edit the message or enter a new customer message for only this transaction.
message.title: Customer Message

otherRefNum.description: If a purchase order number applies to this estimate, enter it here.
otherRefNum.title: PO/Check Number

probability.description: Accept or change the probability that this estimate will be converted to a sale. The Probability field shows the probability of the status selected. If this estimate is for a prospect, the prospect's record is updated with what is entered here. To change the default probability of a status, go to Setup > Sales > Customer Statuses, and click the status you want to change.
probability.title: Probability (%)

shipAddress.description: The default shipping address autofills this field from the customer's record at Lists > Customers. To enter a different address: * Select another address in the Ship To Select field. * Select New in the Ship To Select field to enter a new billing address.
shipAddress.title: Ship To

shipDate.description: Enter, pick or accept the date you expect to ship items ordered.
shipDate.title: Ship Date

startDate.description: If there is an expected closing date for this estimate, accept today's date or enter a new date here.
startDate.title: Start Date

subtotal.description: This field shows the total of the items on this sales order. This is the total before any discounts, shipping cost, handling cost or tax is added to the order.
subtotal.title: Subtotal

title.description: Enter a title for this estimate. The estimate title text appears on lists, shows in search and reporting results, and shows on the Estimates subtab of records it is associated with. When an estimate is converted from an opportunity, the title from the opportunity defaults into the title field on the estimate. If there is already an estimate against the opportunity, then the second estimate has a number following the title. For example, if the first estimate title is “Project Estimate”, then the second estimate title is “Project Estimate1”. For each subsequent estimate created against that opportunity, the number in the title increases by 1 to help distinguish between multiple estimates associated to a single opportunity. The estimate title field is also available for customization, direct list editing, and mass updates.
title.title: Title

toBeEmailed.description: Check this box if you want to email this estimate. Then enter the email address in the space to the right of the check box. You can enter multiple email addresses by separating them with semicolons. It is important to separate the addresses with only semicolons, and do not include any spaces.
toBeEmailed.title: To Be Emailed

toBeFaxed.description: Check this box if you want to fax this estimate. Enter the fax number in the space to the right of the check box if it doesn't already appear. To fax NetSuite forms, an administrator must first set up fax service at Setup > Company > Printing, Fax and Email Preferences.
toBeFaxed.title: To Be Faxed

toBePrinted.description: Check this box if you wish to save this in a queue of estimates to print. Otherwise, you can click Print below to submit and print this estimate at once.
toBePrinted.title: To Be Printed

total.description: NetSuite computes the total of line items and tax and then enters it here.
total.title: Total

trackingNumbers.description: Enter the shipment tracking number from the shipping company. If a tracking number is entered in the exact format used by UPS or FedEx and the transaction is saved, the tracking number will show on the transaction as a link to the UPS or FedEx website. You can click the link to check the status of the shipment.
trackingNumbers.title: Tracking Numbers

tranDate.description: NetSuite inserts today's date for the posting date of this estimate. You can type or pick another date. What you enter here determines the date range in which this transaction appears on the estimate registers. You can select or enter custom date ranges on registers.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: NetSuite increases the largest estimate number by one. If you wish, you can type another number. The next estimate number will revert to the standard pattern.
tranId.title: Estimate #

visibleToCustomer.description: Check the Available in Customer Center box to make this estimate available to customers in the Customer Center. Clear this box to leave this estimate off the list of estimates available to customers in the Customer Center. This field is checked by default.
visibleToCustomer.title: Available In Customer Center

addr1.description: Enter the address the way it should appear on forms. For employees, customers, partners, and vendors, what you enter here autofills on forms if this address is marked default for Shipping or Billing. Enter up to 50 characters. This field is required for the Online Bill Pay feature.
addr1.title: Address 1

addr2.description: Enter an optional second address line the way it should appear on forms. For employees, customers, partners, and vendors, what you enter here autofills on forms if this address is marked default for Shipping or Billing. Enter up to 50 characters.
addr2.title: Address 2

addrText.description: The values entered in the other address fields are displayed here.
addrText.title: Address

addressee.description: Enter the name of the entity that should appear on the shipping label here. This name appears on the shipping label below what you enter in the Attention field.
addressee.title: Addressee

attention.description: Enter the name of the person to whom a shipment is addressed, as it should appear on shipping labels. This field is required for UPS Integration.
attention.title: Attention

city.description: Enter the city the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
city.title: Town

override.description: Check this box to disable the free-form address text field. When this field is disabled, text entered in the other address fields does not display in the Address text field. Clear this box to allow text entered in the address component fields to appear in the free-form address text field.
override.title: Override

state.description: Enter your company's state or province the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
state.title: State/Province

zip.description: Enter the postal code the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
zip.title: Zip

addr1.description: Enter the address the way it should appear on forms. For employees, customers, partners, and vendors, what you enter here autofills on forms if this address is marked default for Shipping or Billing. Enter up to 50 characters. This field is required for the Online Bill Pay feature.
addr1.title: Address 1

addr2.description: Enter an optional second address line the way it should appear on forms. For employees, customers, partners, and vendors, what you enter here autofills on forms if this address is marked default for Shipping or Billing. Enter up to 50 characters.
addr2.title: Address 2

addrText.description: The values entered in the other address fields are displayed here.
addrText.title: Address

addressee.description: Enter the name of the entity that should appear on the shipping label here. This name appears on the shipping label below what you enter in the Attention field.
addressee.title: Addressee

attention.description: Enter the name of the person to whom a shipment is addressed, as it should appear on shipping labels. This field is required for UPS Integration.
attention.title: Attention

city.description: Enter the city the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
city.title: Town

override.description: Check this box to disable the free-form address text field. When this field is disabled, text entered in the other address fields does not display in the Address text field. Clear this box to allow text entered in the address component fields to appear in the free-form address text field.
override.title: Override

state.description: Enter your company's state or province the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
state.title: State/Province

zip.description: Enter the postal code the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
zip.title: Zip

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

defaultrate.description: Enter a default rate to be used on expense reports for this category. This rate can be overridden on individual line items.
defaultrate.title: Default Rate

description.description: Enter a description of the expense category. If you use the Google Checkout Integration feature, enter a description for the tracking URL. This field is optional.
description.title: Description

isinactive.description: Check this box if you want to make this expense category inactive.
isinactive.title: Inactive

name.description: Enter the name of an expense category. If you use the Google Checkout Integration feature, enter a name for the tracking URL. Name the tracking URL for the tracking pixel vendor you use. If you use multiple vendors, you must create a conversion tracking URL record for each vendor.
name.title: Name

personalcorporatecardexpense.description: Check this box to designate this expense category for personal corporate card expenses. Corporate card expense categories can only use other asset accounts. If your company does not use expanded account lists, the corporate card field on expense categories is disabled. Any expense category attached to an other asset account is automatically designated a corporate card expense.
personalcorporatecardexpense.title: Personal Corporate Card Expense

raterequired.description: Check this box to require a quantity and rate when this category is selected on expense reports. Quantity and rate fields are used to calculate the amount on line items with rate required expenses.
raterequired.title: Rate is Required

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

accountingapproval.description: If you have the appropriate accounting authority to approve this report indicating it is ready to pay, place a check mark in this box.
accountingapproval.title: Accounting Approval

advance.description: Enter any advance that should be applied to any reimbursement for these expenses.
advance.title: Advance to Apply

advance2.description: This is the total of any advances applied to this expense report.
advance2.title: Advance to Apply

amount.description: The number NetSuite enters here represents the total of all line items minus any advances and lines marked as non-reimbursable.
amount.title: Total Reimbursable Amount

complete.description: This field shows if this report is complete. Only complete reports are submitted for approval and processing. Note: Once an expense report is marked complete, you can no longer make changes to it.
complete.title: Complete

corporatecard.description: The amount shown has been charged to a corporate credit card and will be reimbursed directly to the card issuer.
corporatecard.title: Corporate Card

duedate.description: Enter the due date of the expense report.
duedate.title: Date Due

expensereportexchangerate.description: Select an exchange rate for this expense report.
expensereportexchangerate.title: Exchange Rate

memo.description: Enter the purpose of the entire expense report.
memo.title: Purpose

nonreimbursable.description: This is the total of any line items below marked as non-reimbursable.
nonreimbursable.title: Non-reimbursable Expenses (Tax Excl.)

reimbursable.description: This is the total of reimbursable expenses from the line items below.
reimbursable.title: Reimbursable Expenses

supervisorapproval.description: If you have the appropriate authority as a supervisor to approve this report, place a check mark in this box.
supervisorapproval.title: Supervisor Approval

total.description: NetSuite will keep track of the total expenses as you add and edit line items below.
total.title: Expenses Total

totalbasecurrency.description: This amount is the total of the expense lines converted to the subsidiary's base currency at the expense report exchange rate.
totalbasecurrency.title: Total in Base Currency

tranDate.description: NetSuite inserts today's date as the date of this expense report. You can type or pick another date.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: NetSuite increases the largest expense report number by one. If you wish, you can type another number. The next expense number will revert to the standard pattern. You can enter a maximum of 45 characters in this field.
tranId.title: Exp. Rept. #

usemulticurrency.description: Check this box if you want to enter expenses in foreign currencies on this expense report. This box is checked by default if you have enabled the Use Multicurrency Expense Reports preference on the General subtab at Home > Set Preferences. Foreign amounts are translated into base currency amounts. Note that exchange rates and converted amounts displayed on expense lines are provided as approximations only. Actual reimbursement amounts will be based on rates at the time of reimbursement.
usemulticurrency.title: Use Multicurrency

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

endDate.description: The End Date is the date that this fair value price expires. When a revenue arrangement is created, its date is checked against this date to determine if this fair value price should be used. You can leave this date blank. If you enter a date here, you must also enter a Start Date. The Start Date must be before the End Date.
endDate.title: End Date

fairValue.description: Enter the base fair value for a unit of the item. This value is used in fair value range checking.
fairValue.title: Base Fair Value

highValue.description: If you enter a number here, the High Value Percent is calculated automatically. Leave this field blank to calculate the value based on the High Value Percent you enter.
highValue.title: High Value

highValuePercent.description: Enter a percent of the base fair value to set the high end of the range. A percent sign is not required. The High Value is automatically calculated.
highValuePercent.title: High Value Percent

isVsoePrice.description: Check this box to indicate that the fair value is based on VSOE. If the box is not checked, the fair value is considered an estimate. Related items have a calculated fair value amount that is a VSOE price when this box is checked.
isVsoePrice.title: Is VSOE Price?

lowValue.description: If you enter a number here, the Low Value Percent is calculated automatically. Leave this field blank to calculate the value based on the Low Value Percent you enter.
lowValue.title: Low Value

lowValuePercent.description: Enter a percent of the base fair value to set the low end of the range. A percent sign is not required. The Low Value is automatically calculated.
lowValuePercent.title: Low Value Percent

startDate.description: The Start Date is the date that this fair value price becomes effective. When a revenue arrangement is created, its date is checked against this date to determine if this fair value price should be used. You can leave this date blank if the End Date is also blank. If you enter a date here, you can leave the End Date blank. If you also enter an End Date, it must be later than the Start Date.
startDate.title: Start Date

units.description: Select a value. When the fair value price includes a value for units and a revenue element includes an alternate quantity, fair value formulas that include {quantity} use the alternate quantity.
units.title: Units

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

memo.description: A note or comment about the fulfillment request. You can also add a note or comment at the line-item level in the Request Note column. For example, you might want to add a comment at line-item level when you reject a line to record the reason for the rejection.
memo.title: Memo

tranDate.description: The date on which the fulfillment request was created. When viewing the fulfillment requests list, you can sort by date.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: A unique number that identifies the fulfillment request. NetSuite generates the number automatically, increasing the largest fulfillment request number by one. If you want, you can type another number.
tranId.title: Fulfillment Number

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

daysBeforeExpiration.description: If you want this item to expire, enter the number of days it should remain active after purchase. If this item is downloadable and the same customer purchases this item more than once, the countdown to expiration restarts with each purchase. Note: If this item is a gift certificate and the buyer lives in California, Connecticut, Louisiana, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island or Washington, by law the gift certificate cannot expire.
daysBeforeExpiration.title: Days Before Expiration

description.description: Enter a description for this item. This description will appear in the Description column of sales forms.
description.title: Description

displayName.description: Enter an optional name of up to 250 characters for this item in addition to the Item Name. If you are integrating with a Yahoo! store, this field is imported from Yahoo!. The display name prints in the Item column of sales forms when Basic printing is used. If this item is a member of a kit, this name appears in the Item column when the Print Items box is checked. If you do not enter a display name, the item name appears on printed forms.
displayName.title: Display Name/Code

dontShowPrice.description: Check this box to hide the price of this item online. This is useful for items you want to advertise but don't want to sell or for items that you track inventory for and want to display but are offered in combination with other items.
dontShowPrice.title: Don't Show Price

excludeFromSiteMap.description: Check this box to exclude a tab, category or item page from the site map.
excludeFromSiteMap.title: Exclude from Sitemap

featuredDescription.description: If this item is displayed on the home page of your Web site, enter a featured description for this item. This description appears below the item's store display name on the Home page of your store or site. You can enter up to 999 characters including basic HTML code. Enter and format text using the formatting options, or click the HTML Source Code link to enter HTML. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
featuredDescription.title: Featured Description

includeChildren.description: Check the Include Children box to share the item with all the sub-subsidiaries associated with each subsidiary selected in the Subsidiary field. Note: When sharing items across subsidiaries, all of the options selected on the item record must be compatible across subsidiaries. For example, when entering an inventory item to be shared across subsidiaries, you should select Income and Asset accounts on the item record that are also shared across the same subsidiaries.
includeChildren.title: Include Children

internalId.description: Use this ID number to create smart tags for your item templates, site templates, and custom Web site that you host with NetSuite.
internalId.title: Internal ID

isFulfillable.description: Check the Can be Fulfilled/Received box to enable this item to be received and fulfilled during order processing. Clear this box if this item does not require being received and fulfilled. Note: Once this item has been added to transactions, this setting cannot be changed. This field is used when the Advanced Billing and Advanced Shipping features are both enabled.
isFulfillable.title: Can be Fulfilled

isInactive.description: When you check this box, this item will no longer appear on a list unless you check the Show All box at the bottom of the list page.
isInactive.title: Inactive

isOnline.description: Check this box to make this item available online in your Web site. You cannot sell this item online unless you check this box. If the item is of the Other Charge for Sale or Resale subtype, checking this box does not make it available in the web store catalog. However, it becomes available during web store checkout.
isOnline.title: Display in Website

itemId.description: Enter up to 250 characters for the name of this item. This name appears in lists on transactions. If you have the option of entering a display name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of sales forms when Basic printing is used. If you have the option to enter a vendor name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you have entered a display name, it will print on purchases instead of the item name when Basic printing is used.
itemId.title: Item Name/Number

metaTagHtml.description: Enter the Meta Tag HTML you want to appear in the < head > section of this item page. Meta tags enable your Web site to be found by search engines.
metaTagHtml.title: Meta Tag HTML

noPriceMessage.description: If you opted to not show a price online, enter the message that should show instead of the price. For example, you might enter "Call for Price."
noPriceMessage.title: No Price Message

salesDescription.description: Enter a sales description for this item. You can enter letters and numbers. There is a 999 character limit. The sales description displays on transactions such as sales orders, cash sales and invoices. If you use the Web Store feature, the sales description displays immediately under the item's store display name on item list pages in your store or site, if you have not entered a store description for an item. Enter the store description on the Store subtab of the item record. The sales description also displays by default when the item is in the Web store shopping cart. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
salesDescription.title: Sales Description

searchKeywords.description: Enter alternative search keywords that customers might use to find this item using your Web store’s internal search. These can include synonyms, acronyms, alternate languages or misspellings. These keywords are seen as equally important as the item name when searches are conducted.
searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords

storeDescription.description: The store description appears under the item's store display name on item list pages in your store or site. To make the store description display when an item is in the Web store shopping cart, go to Setup > Web Site > Set Up Web Site. Click the Cart subtab, and check the box next to Store Description. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
storeDescription.title: Store Description

storeDetailedDescription.description: Enter a detailed description for this item. When your customers click an item's store display name for more information, they see this description. If you are using Internet Explorer, you can also clear the View Source box below to enter and format text using the formatting options above. This eliminates the need for HTML code. If you do not see the View Source box, make sure Rich Text Editing is enabled at Home > Set Preferences > Appearance. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
storeDetailedDescription.title: Detailed Description

storeDisplayName.description: Enter the name of this item as you want it displayed in your Web site. You can enter up to 250 characters.
storeDisplayName.title: Store Display Name

upcCode.description: Enter a maximum of 999 characters in this field to identify an internal name or number to store the item's UPC Code. You can use the text you enter here when adding the item to transactions, searching, or viewing reports. * When you enter text in this field, the SKU/UPC field on item labels displays this UPC Code and prints in UPC bar code format. * When this field is clear, the SKU/UPC field on item labels displays the Item Name/Number and prints in Code-128 bar code format.
upcCode.title: UPC Code

isInactive.description: When you check this box, this item will no longer appear on a list unless you check the Show All box at the bottom of the list page.
isInactive.title: Inactive

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

actualDeliveryDate.description: Use the picker to input the actual date the shipment arrived at the receiving location. The expected and actual dates can be used for the reporting of variances and setting performance metrics.
actualDeliveryDate.title: Actual Delivery Date

actualShippingDate.description: Input a date when the consignment was actually shipped. The expected and actual dates can be used for the reporting of variances and setting performance metrics.
actualShippingDate.title: Actual Shipping Date

billOfLading.description: Enter the number from your bill of lading documentation in this field.
billOfLading.title: Bill Of Lading

expectedDeliveryDate.description: Use the picker to add the date when the shipment is expected to be delivered to the receiving location.
expectedDeliveryDate.title: Expected Delivery Date

expectedShippingDate.description: Use the date picker to insert the date for when the shipment is expected to leave. The field can be edited to reflect changing circumstances.
expectedShippingDate.title: Expected Shipping Date

externalDocumentNumber.description: Add the identifying number for the shipment as supplied by your shipping company here. You can customize the Inbound Shipments list page to include this field for easy identification of the shipment.
externalDocumentNumber.title: External Document Number

shipmentCreatedDate.description: This is a read only field.
shipmentCreatedDate.title: Date Created

shipmentMemo.description: Use this field to highlight key, or frequently used information. It is best practice to add a User Note in the Communications subtab to log call other types of communication relating to the shipment.
shipmentMemo.title: Memo

shipmentNumber.description: This is a system generated number. The format can be customized by updating the Inbound Shipment field at: Setup > Company > Auto-Generated Numbers > Transaction Numbers.
shipmentNumber.title: Shipment Number

vesselNumber.description: Input the vessel's IMO number, or other identifying reference in this field.
vesselNumber.title: Vessel Number

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

approved.description: Check this box to indicate that this journal entry is approved. If you check this box, this journal entry will post immediately. If you do not check this box, this journal entry must be approved before it posts.
approved.title: Approved

exchangeRate.description: This field displays the default exchange rate of the To Subsidiary's currency to the Subsidiary's currency. You can edit the exchange rate for this transaction only, or you can update the currency exchange rates list.
exchangeRate.title: Exchange Rate

memo.description: If you wish, enter a memo to describe this journal entry. It will appear on this transaction detail as well as reports such as a 2-line account register.
memo.title: Memo

reversalDate.description: If this journal entry is intended to be reversed, enter the date for the reversing entry to be posted. If Defer Entry is checked, this field is mandatory.
reversalDate.title: Reversal Date

reversalDefer.description: Check this box to make the reversal a memorized transaction that automatically occurs on the date entered in the required Reversal Date field. Clear this box to make the reversal an immediately entered transaction with the date in the Reversal Date field.
reversalDefer.title: Defer Entry

tranDate.description: NetSuite inserts today's date as the date of this journal entry. You can enter or select another date.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: NetSuite increases the largest journal entry number by one. If you wish, you can type another number. The next journal entry number will revert to the standard pattern. You can enter a maximum of 45 characters in this field.
tranId.title: Entry No.

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

firmed.description: When the Firmed box is checked, the line items are no longer eligible for reallocation to another order. The items must remain committed to the firmed order. Firmed transfer orders are not available to be rescheduled or cancelled.
firmed.title: Firmed

memo.description: Enter a memo to identify this transfer order. When you use the Search Transactions feature, you can search for specific words and phrases in the Memo field.
memo.title: Memo

shipAddress.description: The Ship To Address of the transfer order defaults to the address of the destination location. To enter a different address: * Select another address in the Ship To Select field. * Select New in the Ship To Select field to enter a new billing address.
shipAddress.title: Ship To

shipComplete.description: Check this box if you want to ship this order when there are enough items available to fully fulfill the orders. When fulfilling orders in bulk, you can filter the list to include those orders marked Ship Complete that can be completely fulfilled by selecting Respect Ship Complete in the Filter By field.
shipComplete.title: Ship Complete

shipDate.description: The date defaults to show the current date. You can type or pick another shipping date for this order.
shipDate.title: Ship Date

subtotal.description: As you add items, the total shows in this field.
subtotal.title: Subtotal

total.description: This field shows the total amount associated with this order, including shipping and handling costs.
total.title: Total

trackingNumbers.description: This field displays the tracking number provided by the carrier for the shipment.
trackingNumbers.title: Tracking Numbers

tranDate.description: The current date autofills for this transfer order. You can select or enter a different date.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: Enter the number of this transfer order. If you use autogenerated numbering, the next order number in the sequence shows here. You can enter another number if you choose.
tranId.title: Transaction Number

addr1.description: Enter the address the way it should appear on forms. For employees, customers, partners, and vendors, what you enter here autofills on forms if this address is marked default for Shipping or Billing. Enter up to 50 characters. This field is required for the Online Bill Pay feature.
addr1.title: Address 1

addr2.description: Enter an optional second address line the way it should appear on forms. For employees, customers, partners, and vendors, what you enter here autofills on forms if this address is marked default for Shipping or Billing. Enter up to 50 characters.
addr2.title: Address 2

addrText.description: The values entered in the other address fields are displayed here.
addrText.title: Address

addressee.description: Enter the name of the entity that should appear on the shipping label here. This name appears on the shipping label below what you enter in the Attention field.
addressee.title: Addressee

attention.description: Enter the name of the person to whom a shipment is addressed, as it should appear on shipping labels. This field is required for UPS Integration.
attention.title: Attention

city.description: Enter the city the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
city.title: Town

override.description: Check this box to disable the free-form address text field. When this field is disabled, text entered in the other address fields does not display in the Address text field. Clear this box to allow text entered in the address component fields to appear in the free-form address text field.
override.title: Override

state.description: Enter your company's state or province the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
state.title: State/Province

zip.description: Enter the postal code the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
zip.title: Zip

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

estimatedTotalValue.description: This is the total value of the change in your inventory. When you submit the adjustment, the current cost is determined from your inventory database and your adjustment totals are updated.
estimatedTotalValue.title: Estimated Total Value

memo.description: Enter an optional memo for this adjustment. It will appear on a register or Account Detail report.
memo.title: Memo

tranDate.description: Today's date autofills as the date of this inventory adjustment. You can enter or choose another date.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: Enter an optional reference number for this inventory adjustment. Reference Numbers for inventory adjustments do not have to be consecutive. You can enter a maximum of 45 characters in this field.
tranId.title: Ref No.

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

memo.description: Type a memo for this inventory cost revaluation.
memo.title: Memo

tranDate.description: Type a date for this inventory cost revaluation. The default date is the system date.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: Type a reference number, if required.
tranId.title: Ref No.

unitCost.description: This field displays the revised unit cost after revaluation.
unitCost.title: New Unit Cost

items.title: Items

excludeFromGLNumbering.description: Check this box to exclude inventory count transactions from GL audit numbering.
excludeFromGLNumbering.title: Exclude from GL Audit Numbering

memo.description: Optionally enter a memo for this transaction. Later you can search for this transaction using the text in this field.
memo.title: Memo

tranDate.description: Verify or select a date for this transaction.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: Optionally enter a reference number for this transaction.
tranId.title: Ref No.

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

averageCost.description: This field displays the current average cost of the item across all locations. Using the weighted-average method, the average cost is calculated as the total units available during a period divided by the beginning inventory cost plus the cost of additions to inventory. Note: The average cost calculated per location is listed for each location on the Locations subtab. If you use Multiple Units of Measure, average cost is calculated using stock units.
averageCost.title: Average Cost

baseUnit.description: This field displays the base unit of measure for this item.
baseUnit.title: Primary Base Unit

cost.description: Enter the price you pay for this item. If you do not enter a price, purchase orders for this item show the most recent purchase price by default. If you select a preferred vendor for this item, the price is shown in the currency selected on the vendor's record. If no preferred vendor is selected, the price is shown in your base currency.
cost.title: Purchase Price

description.description: Enter a description for this item. This description will appear in the Description column of sales forms.
description.title: Description

displayName.description: Enter an optional name of up to 250 characters for this item in addition to the Item Name. If you are integrating with a Yahoo! store, this field is imported from Yahoo!. The display name prints in the Item column of sales forms when Basic printing is used. If this item is a member of a kit, this name appears in the Item column when the Print Items box is checked. If you do not enter a display name, the item name appears on printed forms.
displayName.title: Display Name/Code

dontShowPrice.description: Check this box to hide the price of this item online. This is useful for items you want to advertise but don't want to sell or for items that you track inventory for and want to display but are offered in combination with other items.
dontShowPrice.title: Don't Show Price

enforceminqtyinternally.description: Check this box to apply the minimum quantity restriction on sales orders generated from NetSuite. When you clear this box, but enter a number in the Minimum Quantity field, the minimum quantity is only applied to web store orders.
enforceminqtyinternally.title: Enforce Minimum Internally

excludeFromSiteMap.description: Check this box to exclude a tab, category or item page from the site map.
excludeFromSiteMap.title: Exclude from Sitemap

featuredDescription.description: If this item is displayed on the home page of your Web site, enter a featured description for this item. This description appears below the item's store display name on the Home page of your store or site. You can enter up to 999 characters including basic HTML code. Enter and format text using the formatting options, or click the HTML Source Code link to enter HTML. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
featuredDescription.title: Featured Description

froogleProductFeed.description: Check this box to include this item when exporting item lists to Froogle. Clear this box to remove this item when exporting item lists to Froogle.
froogleProductFeed.title: Google Base Product Feed

id.description: Returns the internal ID for the item.
id.title: Internal ID

includeChildren.description: Check the Include Children box to share the item with all the sub-subsidiaries associated with each subsidiary selected in the Subsidiary field. Note: When sharing items across subsidiaries, all of the options selected on the item record must be compatible across subsidiaries. For example, when entering an inventory item to be shared across subsidiaries, you should select Income and Asset accounts on the item record that are also shared across the same subsidiaries.
includeChildren.title: Include Children

internalId.description: Use this ID number to create smart tags for your item templates, site templates, and custom Web site that you host with NetSuite. Smart tags use the following format:
internalId.title: Internal ID

isInactive.description: When you check this box, this item will no longer appear on a list unless you check the Show All box at the bottom of the list page.
isInactive.title: Inactive

isOnline.description: Check this box to make this item available online in your Web site. You cannot sell this item online unless you check this box. If the item is of the Other Charge for Sale or Resale subtype, checking this box does not make it available in the web store catalog. However, it becomes available during web store checkout.
isOnline.title: Display in Website

itemId.description: Enter up to 250 characters for the name of this item. This name appears in lists on transactions. If you have the option of entering a display name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of sales forms when Basic printing is used. If you have the option to enter a vendor name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you have entered a display name, it will print on purchases instead of the item name when Basic printing is used.
itemId.title: Item Name/Number

lastPurchasePrice.description: This field displays the most recent purchase price of the item. This price is determined by the most recent transaction for the item that added positive inventory, such as a purchase receipt, inventory transfer or inventory adjustment. (This does not include item returns or assembly unbuilds.) If two transactions are entered on the same day, the one entered later takes precedence and is used to calculate the last purchase price. When you use the Multiple-Location Inventory feature, the following is true: * The last purchase price reflects the most recent transaction at any location. * The Inventory subtab of inventory item records includes a link to the last positive-inventory transaction per location. * If multiple purchases are made on the same day with different prices and locations, then the highest price paid on that day becomes the last purchase price. If you use Multiple Units of Measure, the last purchase price is calculated using purchase units.
lastPurchasePrice.title: Last Purchase Price

manufacturer.description: Enter the name of the company that manufactures this item.
manufacturer.title: Manufacturer

matchBillToReceipt.description: Check the Match Bill to Receipt box if you want the Match Bill to Receipt box on transaction lines to be checked by default for this item. This enables you to generate variances based on vendor bill lines. Then, on the Post Vendor Bill Variances page, you must select Bill in the Transaction Type field to generate the variance postings. Purchase orders that include this item default to have this box checked and variances are generated based on vendor bill lines. Clear this box if you want to generate variance postings based on purchase order lines rather than vendor bill lines and do not want the Match Bill to Receipt box to be checked by default on transaction lines for this item. Then, on the Post Vendor Bill Variances page, you must select Purchase Order in the Transaction Type field to generate the variance postings. This preference defaults to be disabled. Even when enabled, this option can be changed on individual purchase order lines.
matchBillToReceipt.title: Match Bill To Receipt

maximumquantity.description: Enter the greatest quantity of this item that customers can purchase. If customers enter an item quantity above the maximum amount, a warning message is displayed. Web store customers are unable to complete checkout unless they enter a quantity equal to or below the maximum quantity. Leave this field empty to allow customers to check out without maximum quantity restrictions. You can edit this warning at Setup > Site Builder/SuiteCommerce Advanced > Customize Text.
maximumquantity.title: Maximum Order Qty

metaTagHtml.description: Enter the Meta Tag HTML you want to appear in the < head > section of this item page. Meta tags enable your Web site to be found by search engines.
metaTagHtml.title: Meta Tag HTML

minimumquantity.description: Enter the lowest quantity that customers can purchase. Web store customers receive a warning and cannot check out if they enter an item quantity below this minimum. Leave this field empty to allow customers to check out with no minimum quantity restrictions. You can edit this warning at Setup > Site Builder/SuiteCommerce Advanced > Customize Text.
minimumquantity.title: Minimum Order Qty

mpn.description: MPN (Manufacturers Part Number) - Enter the part number used by the manufacturer to identify this item.
mpn.title: Manufacturer Part Number

nexTagCategory.description: Enter the name of the NexTag category this item should be included in. This category is included in the product feeds you can export at Setup > Web Site > Product Feeds.
nexTagCategory.title: NexTag Category

nexTagProductFeed.description: Check this box to include this item when exporting item lists to NexTag. Clear this box to remove this item when exporting item lists to NexTag.
nexTagProductFeed.title: NexTag Product Feed

noPriceMessage.description: If you opted to not show a price online, enter the message that should show instead of the price. For example, you might enter "Call for Price."
noPriceMessage.title: No Price Message

preferredStockLevel.description: The preferred stock level is the optimum quantity to maintain in stock of an item. The quantity you enter here is used to determine your replenishment needs on the Order Items page. It is the quantity you want to have in stock after an order is placed. * Auto-Calculating – Check the Auto-Calculate box if you want NetSuite to calculate the preferred stock level based on demand for the item. The preferred stock level is calculated as: (daily demand * number of days supply preferred). If no preferred stock level is identified, then the default preferred stock level is used from the Set Up Inventory Management page. * Manually Calculating – Clear the Auto-Calculate box to manually enter the preferred stock quantity. The preferred stock level you set is used to calculate the quantity of items to be ordered on the Order Items page.
preferredStockLevel.title: Preferred Stock Level

purchaseDescription.description: Enter up to 999 characters of text for a description of this item to appear on vendor orders. Include the unit of measure in this description. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
purchaseDescription.title: Purchase Description

purchaseOrderAmount.description: Enter the tolerance limit for the discrepancy between the amount on the vendor bill and purchase order.
purchaseOrderAmount.title: Vendor Bill - Purchase Order Amount Tolerance

purchaseOrderQuantity.description: Enter the tolerance limit for the discrepancy between the quantity on the vendor bill and purchase order.
purchaseOrderQuantity.title: Vendor Bill - Purchase Order Quantity Tolerance

purchaseOrderQuantityDiff.description: Enter the difference limit for the discrepancy between the quantity on the vendor bill and purchase order.
purchaseOrderQuantityDiff.title: Vendor Bill - Purchase Order Quantity Difference

purchaseUnit.description: Select the unit you use to purchase this item from the vendor.
purchaseUnit.title: Primary Purchase Unit

quantityCommitted.description: This field shows the number of this item that are already committed to be sold and are currently showing on orders.
quantityCommitted.title: Quantity Committed

quantityOnHand.description: This field shows the quantity of this item you have on hand.
quantityOnHand.title: Quantity On Hand

quantityOnOrder.description: This field shows the quantity of this item you currently have on order with the vendor.
quantityOnOrder.title: Quantity On Order

reorderMultiple.description: Enter the quantity you prefer to order of this item each time. Then, the Order Items page suggests ordering a quantity of this item that is always multiple of the number you enter. For example, if the vendor only accepts orders in multiples of one thousand, you would enter 1000 in this field. Then, the Order items page might suggest that you order 1000 or 2000, but not 1500. Note: If you use the Multiple Units of Measure feature, the reorder multiple always functions in base units.
reorderMultiple.title: Reorder Multiple

reorderPoint.description: The Reorder Point is the quantity level at which you need to reorder or build more of this item. * Auto-Calculating – Check the Auto-Calculate box if you want NetSuite to calculate the reorder point based on demand for the item over time. The reorder point depends on the safety stock definition and is calculated as follows: o Without safety stock defined: Reorder point = (average lead time days * demand) o With safety stock defined in days: Reorder point = [(average lead time days + safety stock days) * demand] o With safety stock quantity defined: Reorder point = [(average lead time days * demand) + safety stock quantity) * Manually Calculating – Clear the Auto-Calculate box if you want to manually enter the point at which to reorder or build more of this item. If you go to Home > User Preferences and place a check mark in the Inventory Level Warnings box, you are reminded when you have reached the reorder point.
reorderPoint.title: Reorder Point

saleUnit.description: Select the unit you use to sell this item to customers on sales transactions.
saleUnit.title: Primary Sale Unit

salesDescription.description: Enter a sales description for this item. You can enter letters and numbers. There is a 999 character limit. The sales description displays on transactions such as sales orders, cash sales and invoices. If you use the Web Store feature, the sales description displays immediately under the item's store display name on item list pages in your store or site, if you have not entered a store description for an item. Enter the store description on the Store subtab of the item record. The sales description also displays by default when the item is in the Web store shopping cart.
salesDescription.title: Sales Description

scheduleBNumber.description: Enter the number for the Schedule B form for this item.
scheduleBNumber.title: Schedule B Number

searchKeywords.description: Enter alternative search keywords that customers might use to find this item using your Web store’s internal search. These can include synonyms, acronyms, alternate languages or misspellings. These keywords are seen as equally important as the item name when searches are conducted.
searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords

shoppingDotComCategory.description: Enter the name of the Shopping.com category that this item should go under. This category is included in the product feeds that you can export from Setup > Web Site > Product Feeds. Go to www.shopping.com for more information on the categories available. This is an optional field only available for following item records: Kit/Package, Non-inventory Item for Sale, Non-inventory Item for Resale, Assembly (lot and serialized), and Inventory (lot and serialized).

shoppingProductFeed.description: Check this box to include this item when exporting item lists to Shopping.com. Clear this box to remove this item when exporting item lists to Shopping.com.
shoppingProductFeed.title: Shopping Product Feed

shopzillaCategoryId.description: Enter the name of the Shopzilla category this item should be included in. This category is included in the product feeds you export at Setup > Web Site > Product Feeds. Go to www.shopzilla.com for more information on the available categories. This is an optional field only displayed for the following item records: Kit/Package, Non-inventory Item for Sale, Non-inventory Item for Resale, Assembly (lot and serialized), and Inventory (lot and serialized).

shopzillaProductFeed.description: Check this box to include this item when exporting item lists to Shopzilla. Clear this box to remove this item when exporting item lists to Shopzilla.

stockDescription.description: Enter up to 21 characters to specify information about this item, such as New, Refurbished or Ships 2-3 days.

storeDisplayName.description: Enter the name of this item as you want it displayed in your Web site. You can enter up to 250 characters.

totalValue.description: Enter or accept the total value of this item. NetSuite generates this amount by multiplying your purchase price and your quantity on hand. As you buy and sell additional inventory, NetSuite continues to calculate the total value.
totalValue.title: Total Value

upcCode.description: Enter a maximum of 999 characters in this field to identify an internal name or number to store the item's UPC Code. You can use the text you enter here when adding the item to transactions, searching, or viewing reports. * When you enter text in this field, the SKU/UPC field on item labels displays this UPC Code and prints in UPC bar code format. * When this field is clear, the SKU/UPC field on item labels displays the Item Name/Number and prints in Code-128 bar code format.
upcCode.title: UPC Code

vendorName.description: If your vendor uses a name for this item that is different from the name you use, you can enter up to 60 characters as the vendor's name for this item here. The vendor's name for this item prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you do not enter a vendor name, the item name prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you have entered a display name, it will print on purchases instead of the item name.

amountPaid.description: Displays the total amount paid for this invoice.
amountPaid.title: Amount Paid

amountRemaining.description: Displays the total amount due for this invoice.
amountRemaining.title: Amount Remaining

amountRemainingTotalBox.description: The total unpaid amount on this invoice is shown here.
amountRemainingTotalBox.title: Amount Remaining

billAddress.description: The default billing address autofills this field from the customer's record. To enter a different address: * Select another address in the Bill To Select field. * Select New in the Bill To Select field to enter a new billing address to be used for this transaction and saved with the associated entity record. * Select Custom in the Bill To Select field to enter a new billing address to be used for this transaction only (and not saved with the associated entity record). * Click the Edit icon for the Bill To Select field to modify an existing billing address.
billAddress.title: Bill To

discountAmount.description: The amount listed here is the discount your customer will receive if he or she pays this invoice according to the terms you have set.
discountAmount.title: Discount Amount

discountDate.description: The date listed here is the date your customer must pay this invoice by in order to receive a discount. The discount your customer receives in based on the terms you have set for the customer.
discountDate.title: Discount Date

discountRate.description: NetSuite enters the rate for the discount item you selected. You can change the discount rate for this cash refund. Enter the discount as a dollar amount like 10.00, or as a percentage like 10%.
discountRate.title: Rate

discountTotal.description: NetSuite enters the amount discounted on this invoice. If this discount item is taxable, the discount is applied before taxes. If it is not taxable, the discount is applied after taxes.
discountTotal.title: Discount Total

dueDate.description: Type or pick the due date for this invoice. If you do not assign a due date, the due date defaults to the date in the Date field. In addition, if you do not assign a due date, this invoice will appear on aging reports.
dueDate.title: Due Date

endDate.description: Type or pick the end date for this invoice. If an invoice is created from a sales order that includes a Start Date and End Date, those dates autofill on the invoice when the order is billed.
endDate.title: End Date

exchangeRate.description: The currency's exchange rate is shown in this field. You can edit the exchange rate for this transaction only, or you can update the currency record with the exchange rate you enter here.
exchangeRate.title: Exchange Rate

fob.description: Enter the location where the customers technically acquire ownership. For example, if your customers own goods as soon as they ship and pay the shipping costs from your location to theirs, you might enter Our warehouse.
fob.title: FOB

memo.description: Enter an optional memo to describe this invoice so you can easily distinguish it from others for this customer. For example: Suite A installation or Suite B installation. It will appear on reports such as the 2-line Accounts Receivable register, which your customers can see if you give them permission to log in and view their transaction history.
memo.title: Memo

message.description: The text of the customer message you select in the Select Message field appears here. You can edit the message or enter a new customer message for only this transaction.
message.title: Customer Message

otherRefNum.description: To make it easy for your customers to locate this invoice in their own records, enter their purchase order number here.
otherRefNum.title: PO/Check Number

salesEffectiveDate.description: You can change the sales effective date for this transaction. The sales effective date determines which commission plan and historical sales team this transaction applies to.
salesEffectiveDate.title: Sales Effective Date

shipAddress.description: The default shipping address autofills this field from the customer's record. To enter a different address: * Select another address in the Ship To Select field. * Select New in the Ship To Select field to enter a new shipping address to be used for this transaction and saved with the associated entity record. * Select Custom in the Ship To Select field to enter a new shipping address to be used for this transaction only (and not saved with the associated entity record). * Click the Edit icon for the Ship To Select field to edit an existing shipping address.
shipAddress.title: Ship To

shipDate.description: Type or pick a shipping date for this invoice.
shipDate.title: Ship Date

startDate.description: If you use the Advanced Billing feature, enter the date for the first invoice to be created. If an invoice is created from a sales order that includes a Start Date and End Date, those dates autofill on the invoice when the order is billed.
startDate.title: Start Date

subtotal.description: This field shows the total of the items on this invoice. This is the total before any discounts, shipping cost, handling cost or tax is added to the order.
subtotal.title: Subtotal

toBeEmailed.description: When processing individual invoices: * Check the To Be Emailed box if you want to email this invoice. Then enter the email address in the space to the right of the check box. * You can enter multiple email addresses by separating them with a semicolon. It is important to separate the addresses with only a semicolon, and do not include any spaces. When bulk processing invoices: In the To Be Emailed field: * Select Yes if you want to email this form. * Select No if you do not want to email this form. * Select Respect Customer Preference to send the form based on the default preference on the customer record. Set the preference on the Info subtab of a customer record in the Send Transactions Via field.
toBeEmailed.title: To Be Emailed

toBeFaxed.description: When processing individual invoices: * Check the To Be Faxed box if you want to fax this invoice. Then enter the fax number in the box to the right of the check box if it does not already appear. When bulk processing invoices: In the To Be Faxed field: * Select Yes if you want to fax this form. * Select No if you do not want to fax this form. * Select Respect Customer Preference to send the form based on the default preference on the customer record. Set the preference on the Info subtab of a customer record in the Send Transactions Via field. To fax NetSuite forms, an administrator must first set up fax service at Setup > Company > Printing, Fax and Email Preferences.
toBeFaxed.title: To Be Faxed

toBePrinted.description: When processing individual invoices: Check the To Be Printed box if you want to print this invoice. When bulk processing invoices: * Select Yes if you want to save this in a queue of invoices to print. * Select No if you do not want to print this form. * Select Respect Customer Preference to send the form based on the default preference on the customer record. Set the preference on the Info subtab of a customer record in the Send Transactions Via field.
toBePrinted.title: To Be Printed

total.description: NetSuite computes the total of line items, tax and shipping costs, and then enters it here.
total.title: Total

trackingNumbers.description: Enter the shipment tracking number from the shipping company. If a tracking number is entered in the exact format used by UPS or FedEx and the transaction is saved, the tracking number will show on the transaction as a link to the UPS or FedEx website. You can click the link to check the status of the shipment.

tranDate.description: NetSuite inserts today's date for the posting date of this invoice. You can type or pick another date. What you enter here determines the date range in which this transaction appears on the Accounts Receivable Register. You can select or enter custom date ranges on registers.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: NetSuite increases the largest invoice number by one. You can type another number. The next invoice number will revert to the standard pattern.
tranId.title: Invoice #

displayName.description: Enter an optional name of up to 250 characters for this item in addition to the Item Name. If you are integrating with a Yahoo! store, this field is imported from Yahoo!. The display name prints in the Item column of sales forms when Basic printing is used. If this item is a member of a kit, this name appears in the Item column when the Print Items box is checked. If you do not enter a display name, the item name appears on printed forms.
displayName.title: Display Name/Code

includeChildren.description: Check the Include Children box to share the item with all the sub-subsidiaries associated with each subsidiary selected in the Subsidiary field. Note: When sharing items across subsidiaries, all of the options selected on the item record must be compatible across subsidiaries. For example, when entering an inventory item to be shared across subsidiaries, you should select Income and Asset accounts on the item record that are also shared across the same subsidiaries.
includeChildren.title: Include Children

includeStartEndLines.description: Choose whether the start and end lines of the item group are referenced for sorting picking tickets that include item groups. * Clear the Include Start/End Lines box to delete the start or end line of the group on picking tickets. Then, component items for the group are sorted with other items on the picking ticket. * Check the Include Start/End Lines box to recognize the start or end line of the group on picking tickets.

If you have the option to enter a vendor name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you have entered a display name, it will print on purchases instead of the item name when Basic printing is used.
itemId.title: Item Name/Number

printItems.description: Check this box to display the member items with their respective display names, quantities and descriptions on sales and purchase forms. Clear this box to display only the description and amount of the group or kit on sales and purchase forms. Note: Assembly items do not display on purchase forms even when this box is checked. Also note that member items are never shown on printed forms; only one line with the group name and summary is printed.
printItems.title: Print Items

upcCode.description: Enter a maximum of 999 characters in this field to identify an internal name or number to store the item's UPC Code. NetSuite does not allow the lag amount to be defined outside of this range. Note: The autocalculation setting can be changed only when the work order status is Planned or Released.
