isFulfillable.description: Check the Can be Fulfilled/Received box to enable this item to be received and fulfilled during order processing. isInactive.description: When you check this box, this item will no longer appear on a list unless you check the Show All box at the bottom of the list page.

itemId.description: Enter up to 250 characters for the name of this item. This name appears in lists on transactions. manufacturer.description: Enter the name of the company that manufactures this item.

maximumquantity.description: Enter the greatest quantity of this item that customers can purchase. If customers enter an item quantity above the maximum amount, a warning message is displayed. metaTagHtml.description: Enter the Meta Tag HTML you want to appear in the < head > section of this item page. Meta tags enable your Web site to be found by search engines.

minimumquantity.description: Enter the lowest quantity that customers can purchase. Web store customers receive a warning and cannot check out if they enter an item quantity below this minimum. saleUnit.description: Select the unit you use to sell this item to customers on sales transactions.

This field is required for the Online Bill Pay feature.
addr1.title: Address 1

addr2.description: Enter an optional second address line the way it should appear on forms. For employees, customers, partners, and vendors, what you enter here autofills on forms if this address is marked default for Shipping or Billing. Enter up to 50 characters.
addr2.title: Address 2

addrText.description: The values entered in the other address fields are displayed here.
addrText.title: Address

addressee.description: Enter the name of the entity that should appear on the shipping label here. This name appears on the shipping label below what you enter in the Attention field.
addressee.title: Addressee

attention.description: Enter the name of the person to whom a shipment is addressed, as it should appear on shipping labels. This field is required for UPS Integration.
attention.title: Attention

city.description: Enter the city the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
city.title: Town

override.description: Check this box to disable the free-form address text field. When this field is disabled, text entered in the other address fields does not display in the Address text field. Clear this box to allow text entered in the address component fields to appear in the free-form address text field.
override.title: Override

state.description: Enter your company's state or province the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
state.title: State/Province

zip.description: Enter the postal code the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
zip.title: Zip

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

description.description: Enter a description of this sales role.
description.title: Description

isInactive.description: Check this box to make this sales role inactive.
isInactive.title: Inactive

isSalesRep.description: Check this box if this role is for sales reps. Employees with sales rep sales roles appear on sales reports and KPIs.
isSalesRep.title: Sales Rep

name.description: Enter the name of this sales role.
name.title: Role

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

description.description: Enter a description for this record.
description.title: Description

isInactive.description: Check this box to inactivate this record. Inactive records do not show on transactions and records for selection in lists.
isInactive.title: Inactive

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

amortizationPeriod.description: Enter the number of periods over which the purchase amount should be amortized. For example, enter 60 to amortize the amount over 60 periods starting from the amortization start date. Note: The starting period is specified by the amortization start date on bills. If no amortization start date is specified, the posting date of the bill is the amortization start date.
amortizationPeriod.title: Amortization Period

cost.description: Enter the price you pay for this item. If you do not enter a price, purchase orders for this item show the most recent purchase price by default. If you select a preferred vendor for this item, the price is shown in the currency selected on the vendor's record. If no preferred vendor is selected, the price is shown in your base currency.
cost.title: Purchase Price

displayName.description: Enter an optional name of up to 250 characters for this item in addition to the Item Name. If you are integrating with a Yahoo! store, this field is imported from Yahoo!. The display name prints in the Item column of sales forms when Basic printing is used. If this item is a member of a kit, this name appears in the Item column when the Print Items box is checked. If you do not enter a display name, the item name appears on printed forms.
displayName.title: Display Name/Code

includeChildren.description: Check the Include Children box to share the item with all the sub-subsidiaries associated with each subsidiary selected in the Subsidiary field. Note: When sharing items across subsidiaries, all of the options selected on the item record must be compatible across subsidiaries. For example, when entering an inventory item to be shared across subsidiaries, you should select Income and Asset accounts on the item record that are also shared across the same subsidiaries.
includeChildren.title: Include Children

isFulfillable.description: Check the Can be Fulfilled/Received box to enable this item to be received and fulfilled during order processing. Clear this box if this item does not require being received and fulfilled. Note: Once this item has been added to transactions, this setting cannot be changed. This field is used when the Advanced Billing and Advanced Shipping features are both enabled.
isFulfillable.title: Can be Fulfilled

isInactive.description: When you check this box, this item will no longer appear on a list unless you check the Show All box at the bottom of the list page.
isInactive.title: Inactive

itemId.description: Enter up to 250 characters for the name of this item. This name appears in lists on transactions. If you have the option of entering a display name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of sales forms when Basic printing is used. If you have the option to enter a vendor name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you have entered a display name, it will print on purchases instead of the item name when Basic printing is used.
itemId.title: Item Name/Number

purchaseDescription.description: Enter up to 999 characters of text for a description of this item to appear on vendor orders. Include the unit of measure in this description.
purchaseDescription.title: Purchase Description

purchaseOrderAmount.description: Enter the tolerance limit for the discrepancy between the amount on the vendor bill and purchase order.
purchaseOrderAmount.title: Vendor Bill - Purchase Order Amount Tolerance

purchaseOrderQuantity.description: Enter the tolerance limit for the discrepancy between the quantity on the vendor bill and purchase order.
purchaseOrderQuantity.title: Vendor Bill - Purchase Order Quantity Tolerance

purchaseOrderQuantityDiff.description: Enter the difference limit for the discrepancy between the quantity on the vendor bill and purchase order.
purchaseOrderQuantityDiff.title: Vendor Bill - Purchase Order Quantity Difference

purchaseUnit.description: Select the unit you use to purchase this item from the vendor.
purchaseUnit.title: Primary Purchase Unit

residual.description: Enter an amount or percentage to remain in the deferral account and not be amortized. A residual amount generally represents the salvage value of a fixed asset. Note: A residual amount entered on a transaction overrides a residual amount entered on an item record.
residual.title: Residual

upcCode.description: Enter a maximum of 999 characters in this field to identify an internal name or number to store the item's UPC Code. You can use the text you enter here when adding the item to transactions, searching, or viewing reports. * When you enter text in this field, the SKU/UPC field on item labels displays this UPC Code and prints in UPC bar code format. * When this field is clear, the SKU/UPC field on item labels displays the Item Name/Number and prints in Code-128 bar code format.
upcCode.title: UPC Code

vendorName.description: If your vendor uses a name for this item that is different from the name you use, you can enter up to 60 characters as the vendor's name for this item here. The vendor's name for this item prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you do not enter a vendor name, the item name prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you have entered a display name, it will print on purchases instead of the item name.
vendorName.title: Vendor Name/Code

items.title: Items

If you do not enter a display name, the item name appears on printed forms.
displayName.title: Display Name/Code

dontShowPrice.description: Check this box to hide the price of this item online. This is useful for items you want to advertise but don't want to sell or for items that you track inventory for and want to display but are offered in combination with other items.
dontShowPrice.title: Don't Show Price

enforceminqtyinternally.description: Check this box to apply the minimum quantity restriction on sales orders generated from NetSuite. When you clear this box, but enter a number in the Minimum Quantity field, the minimum quantity is only applied to web store orders.
enforceminqtyinternally.title: Enforce Minimum Internally

excludeFromSiteMap.description: Check this box to exclude a tab, category or item page from the site map.
excludeFromSiteMap.title: Exclude from Sitemap

featuredDescription.description: If this item is displayed on the home page of your Web site, enter a featured description for this item. This description appears below the item's store display name on the Home page of your store or site. You can enter up to 999 characters including basic HTML code. Enter and format text using the formatting options, or click the HTML Source Code link to enter HTML.
featuredDescription.title: Featured Description

includeChildren.description: Check the Include Children box to share the item with all the sub-subsidiaries associated with each subsidiary selected in the Subsidiary field. Note: When sharing items across subsidiaries, all of the options selected on the item record must be compatible across subsidiaries. For example, when entering an inventory item to be shared across subsidiaries, you should select Income and Asset accounts on the item record that are also shared across the same subsidiaries.
includeChildren.title: Include Children

isFulfillable.description: Check the Can be Fulfilled/Received box to enable this item to be received and fulfilled during order processing. Clear this box if this item does not require being received and fulfilled. Note: Once this item has been added to transactions, this setting cannot be changed. This field is used when the Advanced Billing and Advanced Shipping features are both enabled.
isFulfillable.title: Can be Fulfilled

isInactive.description: When you check this box, this item will no longer appear on a list unless you check the Show All box at the bottom of the list page.
isInactive.title: Inactive

isOnline.description: Check this box to make this item available online in your Web site. You cannot sell this item online unless you check this box. If the item is of the Other Charge for Sale or Resale subtype, checking this box does not make it available in the web store catalog. However, it becomes available during web store checkout.
isOnline.title: Display in Website

itemId.description: Enter up to 250 characters for the name of this item. This name appears in lists on transactions. If you have the option to enter a vendor name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you have entered a display name, it will print on purchases instead of the item name when Basic printing is used.
itemId.title: Item Name/Number

maximumquantity.description: Enter the greatest quantity of this item that customers can purchase. If customers enter an item quantity above the maximum amount, a warning message is displayed. Web store customers are unable to complete checkout unless they enter a quantity equal to or below the maximum quantity. Leave this field empty to allow customers to check out without maximum quantity restrictions. You can edit this warning at Setup > Site Builder/SuiteCommerce Advanced > Customize Text.
maximumquantity.title: Maximum Order Qty

metaTagHtml.description: Enter the Meta Tag HTML you want to appear in the < head > section of this item page. Meta tags enable your Web site to be found by search engines.
metaTagHtml.title: Meta Tag HTML

minimumquantity.description: Enter the lowest quantity that customers can purchase. Web store customers receive a warning and cannot check out if they enter an item quantity below this minimum. Leave this field empty to allow customers to check out with no minimum quantity restrictions. You can edit this warning at Setup > Site Builder/SuiteCommerce Advanced > Customize Text.

noPriceMessage.description: If you opted to not show a price online, enter the message that should show instead of the price. For example, you might enter "Call for Price."

saleUnit.description: Select the unit you use to sell this item to customers on sales transactions.
saleUnit.title: Primary Sale Unit

salesDescription.description: Enter a sales description for this item. You can enter letters and numbers. There is a 999 character limit. If you use the Web Store feature, the sales description displays immediately under the item's store display name on item list pages in your store or site, if you have not entered a store description for an item. searchKeywords.description: Enter alternative search keywords that customers might use to find this item using your Web store’s internal search. These can include synonyms, acronyms, alternate languages or misspellings. These keywords are seen as equally important as the item name when searches are conducted.
searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords

storeDescription.description: The store description appears under the item's store display name on item list pages in your store or site. You can enter letters, numbers, and basic HTML code. Note: To make the store description display when an item is in the Web store shopping cart, go to Setup > Web Site > Set Up Web Site. Click the Cart subtab, and check the box next to Store Description.

storeDetailedDescription.description: Enter a detailed description for this item. When your customers click an item's store display name for more information, they see this description. description.title: Description

displayName.description: Enter the name for the shipping item that you want to appear on printed invoices, in your Web store, and centers such as the Customer Center. In all other places, the Ship Name displays.
displayName.title: Display Name/Code

fedexDiscountRate.description: To offer a discounted FedEx rate, enter the discount rate in decimal form. This amount is multiplied by the real-time rate to display the total discounted rate. For example, if you want to offer a 25% discount, enter 0.75. Note: To offer free shipping, use promotion codes or create a shipping item with a flat rate of $0.00.
fedexDiscountRate.title: Discount Rate

fedexOneRate.description: Check this box if the package qualifies. FedEx One Rate is flat-rate shipping that doesn't require you to weigh or measure shipments under 50 lbs.
fedexOneRate.title: FedEx One Rate®

invt_DispName.description: Enter the translation that you want to display for this item, if shoppers can view your site in a different language.
invt_DispName.title: Display Name

isInactive.description: When you check this box, this shipping item will no longer appear on a list unless you check the Show All box at the bottom of the Shipping Items page.
isInactive.title: Inactive

itemId.description: Enter a name for this shipping item. This name appears on transaction pages, lists and all other internal facing documents.
itemId.title: Ship Name

omitPackaging.description: Check this box to disable the automatic packaging logic that occurs during item fulfillment and create only one package for the order.
omitPackaging.title: Omit packaging

shipItemCurrency.description: Identifies the currency for the subsidiary.
shipItemCurrency.title: Currency

upsDiscountRate.description: Enter a number to multiply the rate by to receive the correct discount. For example, if you want to offer a 25% discount off the real-time rate USPS returns, enter 0.75.
upsDiscountRate.title: Discount Rate

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

absoluteUpdate.description: Check this box to update the balance of multiple statistical accounts at the same time. The account balances you enter overwrite all previous values. Absolute values are available to you through reporting and for use in dynamic allocation schedules.
absoluteUpdate.title: Absolute Update

approved.description: Check this box to indicate that this journal entry is approved. If you check this box, this journal entry will post immediately. If you do not check this box, this journal entry must be approved before it posts.
approved.title: Approved

memo.description: If you wish, enter a memo to describe this journal entry. It will appear on this transaction detail as well as reports such as a 2-line account register.
memo.title: Memo

reversalDate.description: If this journal entry is intended to be reversed, enter the date for the reversing entry to be posted. If Defer Entry is checked, this field is mandatory.
reversalDate.title: Reversal Date

reversalDefer.description: Check this box to make the reversal a memorized transaction that automatically occurs on the date entered in the required Reversal Date field. Clear this box to make the reversal an immediately entered transaction with the date in the Reversal Date field.
reversalDefer.title: Defer Entry

total.description: In this field, NetSuite keeps track of the difference between the debits and credits you enter below. If this field does not equal 0.00, NetSuite will not allow you to submit this transaction.
total.title: Total

tranDate.description: NetSuite inserts today's date as the date of this journal entry. You can enter or select another date.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: NetSuite increases the largest journal entry number by one. If you wish, you can type another number. The next journal entry number will revert to the standard pattern. You can enter a maximum of 45 characters in this field.
tranId.title: Entry No.

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

autoRenewal.description: Check this box to automatically renew the subscription. After checking this box, enter a date by which you want to renew the subscription before it expires. The renewal process can include negotiating pricing, subscription terms, and other subscription details.
autoRenewal.title: Automatically Initiate Renewal Process

endDate.description: The contracted end of the subscription. For a standard-term subscription, equal to the subscription start date plus the indicated subscription term. For a custom-term subscription, the subscription-level end date also must be set at the subscription level.
endDate.title: End Date

idNumber.description: The automatically generated number identifying this subscription.
idNumber.title: Number

lastBillCycleDate.description: The start date for the next billing cycle.
lastBillCycleDate.title: Last Bill Cycle Date

lastBillDate.description: The date of the last invoice.
lastBillDate.title: Last Bill Date

name.description: Enter a name to identify the subscription. If you leave this field blank, NetSuite automatically generates a subscription name upon saving.
name.title: Name

nextBillCycleDate.description: The next bill date for this Billing Account.
nextBillCycleDate.title: Next Bill Cycle Date

nextRenewalStartDate.description: The start date for the next renewal of this subscription.
nextRenewalStartDate.title: Next Renewal Start Date

startDate.description: The contracted start date for the subscription. You must specify the subscription-level start date, or it defaults to the current date. Defines the earliest possible activation date for the subscription line items. Remains editable until any subscription line item becomes active.
startDate.title: Start Date

subscriptionRevision.description: The current revision number for the subscription. The revision number increases when you create a change order on the subscription. The first activation is revision 1. Another revision is created whenever a change order is saved.
subscriptionRevision.title: Subscription Revision

effectiveDate.description: The date on which the change order takes effect.
effectiveDate.title: Effective Date

idNumber.description: The automatically generated number identifying this subscription.
idNumber.title: Number

memo.description: Use this fields to enter notes.
memo.title: Memo

requestOffCycleInvoice.description: Select to set the default for off-cycle invoices, which is inherited from other records. An off-cycle invoice bills for subscriptions with a partial period. For example, sending a bill before the recurring scheduled bills.
requestOffCycleInvoice.title: Request Off-Cycle Invoice for Advance Charges

items.title: Items

endDate.description: The scheduled end date for this line item on the subscription.
endDate.title: End Date

externalId.description: Unique identification number assigned to the item. This is a system-generated read-only field.
externalId.title: External ID

autoRenewal.description: Check this box to automatically start the renewal process on the date specified in the Before Subscription End Date field.
autoRenewal.title: Automatically Initiate Renewal Process

description.description: (optional) A name or code to be displayed in place of the Subscription Plan Name.
description.title: Description

displayName.description: Enter an optional display name for the subscription plan.
displayName.title: Display Name/Code

includeChildren.description: Check this box if you want to include subcustomers or subsidiaries.

isInactive.description: Check this box if this subscription plan is no longer active.

itemId.description: Enter a name to identify the subscription plan.

email.description: Enter the return email address for this subsidiary.
email.title: Return Email Address

fax.description: Enter the fax number for this subsidiary.
fax.title: Fax

internalId.description: Either the internalID or externalID field is required for update, delete and get operations.
internalId.title: Internal ID

isElimination.description: Check this box if this subsidiary record is to be used for only journal entries and transactions between subsidiaries. When a loan, sale, or inventory transfer is made between subsidiaries, you use an elimination subsidiary to balance your consolidated books. By entering a journal entry against the elimination subsidiary in the same amount as the inter-company transaction, you have both a record of the transactions and a correct balance.
isElimination.title: Elimination

isInactive.description: Check this box if this subsidiary is no longer active or used in your account. Inactivated subsidiaries no longer show in the Subsidiary field on records and transactions unless they are currently attached to a record. Web sites of inactive subsidiaries are no longer available online.
isInactive.title: Subsidiary is Inactive

legalName.description: Enter the legal name of this subsidiary as it should appear on tax forms.
legalName.title: Legal Name

name.description: Enter the name of this subsidiary the way it should appear on all forms except checks. On checks, your company name is pre-printed with address and MICR information. The name can be alphanumeric. The maximum number of characters is 83.
name.title: Name

state.description: Select the state or province in which this subsidiary is located.
state.title: State

tranInternalPrefix.description: When you use auto-generated numbering with NetSuite OneWorld, you can make your transaction number sequences independent per subsidiary. Enter up to 8 alphanumeric characters in this field to number transactions with a prefix to signify this subsidiary. To set up auto-generated numbering, go to Setup > Company > Setup Tasks > Auto-Generated Numbers. On the Transaction Numbers subtab, check the Use Subsidiary box next to each transaction to which this prefix should be applied.
tranInternalPrefix.title: Transaction Number Prefix

url.description: Enter this subsidiary's Web Site address, or URL.
url.title: Web Site

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

description.description: Enter a description for this item. This description will appear in the Description column of sales forms.
description.title: Description

displayName.description: Enter an optional name of up to 250 characters for this item in addition to the Item Name. If you are integrating with a Yahoo! store, this field is imported from Yahoo!. The display name prints in the Item column of sales forms when Basic printing is used. If this item is a member of a kit, this name appears in the Item column when the Print Items box is checked. If you do not enter a display name, the item name appears on printed forms.
displayName.title: Display Name/Code

includeChildren.description: Check the Include Children box to share the item with all the sub-subsidiaries associated with each subsidiary selected in the Subsidiary field. Note: When sharing items across subsidiaries, all of the options selected on the item record must be compatible across subsidiaries. For example, when entering an inventory item to be shared across subsidiaries, you should select Income and Asset accounts on the item record that are also shared across the same subsidiaries.
includeChildren.title: Include Children

isInactive.description: When you check this box, this item will no longer appear on a list unless you check the Show All box at the bottom of the list page.
isInactive.title: Inactive

itemId.description: Enter up to 250 characters for the name of this item. This name appears in lists on transactions. If you have the option of entering a display name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of sales forms when Basic printing is used. If you have the option to enter a vendor name and do not, the item name prints in the Item column of purchase forms. If you have entered a display name, it will print on purchases instead of the item name when Basic printing is used.
itemId.title: Item Name/Number

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

autoName.description: This field is available only if you are allowed to override automatically generated numbers for cases. Clear this box to make the Number field editable rather than auto-generated.
autoName.title: Auto

caseNumber.description: If you use auto-generated numbering, this number is automatically assigned to give the case a unique identifier. You can use this case number to quickly access this case using the case search or the Global Search field.
caseNumber.title: ID

createdDate.description: The date and time that this case record was first created shows in this field.
createdDate.title: Creation Date/Time

dateCreated.description: The date and time when the case was created.
dateCreated.title: Creation Date/Time

email.description: Enter the individual or company contact's email address. You can enter multiple email addresses separated by commas or semicolons. If you check the Email reply box, your response is emailed to these addresses.
email.title: Emails

emailEmployees.description: Select other employees whom you would like to send information on this case to. Press and hold CTRL to select more than one name. An email notification with the case's details is sent to these employees when you save this record. Check the Email Reply box to send case messages to both the customer and the employees selected here.
emailEmployees.title: Copy Employees

emailForm.description: Check this box to email your reply to the customer's email as entered in the Email field above. When editing a case, you can also send email to customers or employees using the Email button on the Messages subtab.
emailForm.title: Email reply

endDate.description: The date and time when the case was closed.
endDate.title: Date Closed

escalationMessage.description: Enter a message that will be e-mailed to the person you are escalating this case to. The customer does not receive a copy of this e-mail message. The message is not stored in the case record. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
escalationMessage.title: Escalation Message

externalId.description: Returns the case's external ID, if one is assigned.
externalId.title: External ID

firstUpdated.description: The date and time when the case was first worked on (first edit).
firstUpdated.title: First updated

incomingMessage.description: If this case was submitted by a customer, the customer's most recent message appears here. If you are creating this case, enter the problem or question here. If you change the customer or company who submitted this case, the last message remains, even if it is from the previous company. To view all past messages, click View History on the Messages subtab. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
incomingMessage.title: Message

initialResponseTime.description: The duration between the time the case was created and the first response to the customer.
initialResponseTime.title: Initial Response Time

internalOnly.description: Check this box if you do not want your reply to be seen by customers. Only people in your company who view this case record can see your internal message. When editing a case, you can also send email to customers or employees using the Email button on the Messages subtab.
internalOnly.title: Internal Only

isInactive.description: Check this box if you want to remove this case from the cases list. To view inactive cases, you can check the Show Inactives box at the bottom of the list.
isInactive.title: Inactive

lastCustomerMessageReceived.description: The date and time of the last message received from the customer.
lastCustomerMessageReceived.title: Last Customer Message Received

lastMessageDate.description: The date and time of the last message received or sent relating to the case.
lastMessageDate.title: Last Message Date

lastModifiedDate.description: The date and time when the case was last worked on. This field updates automatically when a message is received from a contact and when a message is submitted to a contact.
lastModifiedDate.title: Last Modified Date/Time

lastReopenedDate.description: The date and time when the case was last changed from Closed to Re-opened.
lastReopenedDate.title: Date Last Reopened

messageNew.description: Check this box to add a new message from the customer. This might be needed if the customer calls in and his or her question needs to be documented. When you check this box, Message field clears so that you can enter the new message. If the box isn't checked, the customer's most recent message shows in the Message field. All previous messages from and to the customer are listed on the Message subtab.
messageNew.title: New Message

outgoingMessage.description: Use this field to enter a reply to the message. This can be an answer, solution or request for more information based on the information in the Message field. Check the Send Email box to email this reply to the email address saved on this case record. Check the Internal Only box to email this reply only to those selected in the Email Employees field. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
outgoingMessage.title: Reply

phone.description: Enter the contact's phone number for this case. This phone number can be used by support or IT to follow up on a case.
phone.title: Phone

quickNote.description: You can enter information in this field that you want to keep separate from the case details. This note can only be seen by others in your company with access to this case. You can add this field to your cases list view and enter information on the list page using the Inline Editing feature.
quickNote.title: Quick Note

startDate.description: Enter, accept or click the calendar to pick the date this case is being reported. This date shows on the Cases list, and the list can be filtered by date. The date also shows on the Case subtab of completed company, customer and solution records.
startDate.title: Incident Date

startTime.description: Enter or accept the time that this case is being reported. This time shows under the date on the Cases list. The time also shows on the Cases subtab of completed company, customer, and solution records.
startTime.title: Incident Time

supportFirstReply.description: The date and time of when the first reply message was sent to the customer.
supportFirstReply.title: Support First Reply

timeElapsed.description: Total number of hours the case has been actively running, excluding time spent on hold.
timeElapsed.title: Time Elapsed

timeOnHold.description: Total number of hours the case has been on hold since case creation.
timeOnHold.title: Time On Hold

timeOpen.description: Total number of hours the case has not been on hold or closed (includes standard statuses and customizations of Not Started, In progress, Escalated, Reopened.)
timeOpen.title: Time Open

timeToAssign.description: The time between when the case was created and when it was assigned
timeToAssign.title: Time To Assign

timeToClose.description: The difference between Date Created and Date Closed.
timeToClose.title: Time To Close

title.description: Enter the subject of this case. You can enter up to 256 characters in this field. The subject shows in the second column of the Cases list, and it is a useful way to determine what the case is about. On saved records for individuals or companies who submit cases, the subject appears in the Title column of the Cases subtab. If you use the Knowledge Base feature, the subject also appears on the Cases subtab of completed solution records.
title.title: Subject

useEmployeeTemplate.description: Check this box if you want to use the employee template selected at Setup > Support > Preferences > Support Preferences > Notification in the Copy Employee Template field for the email sent to employees to notify them of changes to this case. Keep this box clear if you want to use the customer template for the email sent to employees. Note: Email is only sent if the Send to Customer box is also checked.
useEmployeeTemplate.title: Use Employee Template

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

accessLevel.description: Check this box so that only the creator of this task or person assigned this task can view the task. If you don't check this box, this task is considered public and can be viewed on all task lists.
accessLevel.title: Private

completedDate.description: Enter the date this task was actually completed.
completedDate.title: Date Completed

dueDate.description: Enter the projected date when this task needs to be complete.
dueDate.title: Due Date

endTime.description: Enter the end time for placing this task on the assignee's calendar. You must check the Block Out Time box to set a time in this field.
endTime.title: End time

message.description: Enter any comments about this task. These comments appear in the e-mail sent to the person this task is assigned to.
message.title: Comments

order.description: Choose the placement of this task on your task list or the person's tasks list you are assigning this to. Leave this field blank to place this task last on the tasks list.
order.title: Insert Before

sendEmail.description: Check this box to send an email message to the person this task is assigned to. The person the task is assigned to also receives an e-mail message when this task is updated if the Send e-mail box is checked. If this person's record does not include an email address, no message will be sent.
sendEmail.title: Send email

startDate.description: This is the date the task should be started. If you are entering or editing the task, type or pick the start date of the task. This date is included in the e-mail to the assignee.
startDate.title: Start Date

startTime.description: Enter the start time for placing this task on the assignee's calendar. You must check the Block Out Time box to set a time in this field.
startTime.title: Start Time

timedEvent.description: Check this box to schedule this task on the calendar of the person the task is assigned to. Enter the start and end times in the From and To fields. This time is scheduled on the calendar for the start date.
timedEvent.title: Timed Event

title.description: Enter a name for this task. This name is the subject line of the e-mail sent to the assignee if you check the Send e-mail box. This title also appears to others if the Private Task box is not checked. The title shows on the Tasks list.

dayDiscountExpires.description: If you offer a discount for early payment under date driven terms, enter the last day of the month the early payment discount is available. For example, if the early payment discount is available through the 20th of each month, enter 20 in this field.
dayDiscountExpires.title: Day Discount Expires

dayOfMonthNetDue.description: For date driven terms, enter the day of the month when the net amount of the invoice is due. If you enter a date that does not exist in the month the transaction is due, the last day of the month becomes the due date.
dayOfMonthNetDue.title: Day Of Month Net Due

daysUntilExpiry.description: For standard terms, enter the number of days the early payment discount is available. For example, if the early payment discount is available for 15 days after the bill is issued, enter 15 in this field.
daysUntilExpiry.title: Days Till Discount Expires

daysUntilNetDue.description: Enter the number of days until the net amount of the bill becomes due. For example, if you are creating a term of Net 30, enter 30 in this field.
daysUntilNetDue.title: Days Till Net Due

discountPercent.description: For standard terms, enter the percentage discount if the invoice is paid early.
discountPercent.title: % Discount

discountPercentDateDriven.description: For date driven terms, enter the percentage discount if the invoice is paid early.
discountPercentDateDriven.title: Date Driven % Discount

dueNextMonthIfWithinDays.description: For date driven terms, enter the number of days before the due date that the invoice can be postponed until the next month's due date. For example, if invoices are due on the 30th of each month and you enter 5 in this field, then invoices issued between the 25th and 30th are due for payment by the 30th of the following month. For another example, Day of Month Net Due = 15 and Due Next Month if Within Days = 30 Date range within 30 days: 5/16-6/14 move to 7/15 6/15-7/15 move to 8/15 8/16-9/14 move to 10/15 9/15-10/15 move to 11/15 10/16-11/14 move to 12/15 11/15-12/15 move to 1/5
dueNextMonthIfWithinDays.title: Due Next Month If Within Days

name.title: Terms

preferred.description: Check this box to make this term or message show by default on sales transactions you create. Note: Terms set on customer records override terms marked as preferred.
preferred.title: Preferred

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

displayField.description: Returns the date, internal ID, and time stamp for the user's last time tracking.
displayField.title: Time Tracking

externalId.description: Returns the external ID for the time bill, if one is specified.
externalId.title: External ID

hours.description: If you filled in the Start Time, End Time and Break fields, NetSuite automatically fills in the Duration field for you. If you didn't fill in these fields, enter the total time worked in hours and minutes. If you want to time yourself as you work, click the Timer link next to the Duration field.
hours.title: Duration

id.description: Returns the internal ID for the time bill.
id.title: Internal ID

isBillable.description: Check this box if the time you are entering can be billed.
isBillable.title: Billable

memo.description: If you want, enter a memo for this time transaction. If you are billing this time back to a customer or job, this memo appears as a description for this line item on the customer invoice.
memo.title: Memo

overrideRate.description: If you're billing this time back to a customer, check this box to lock the rate you enter so it's not affected by rate changes that happen before the customer is billed. If you're entering time for a charge-based project and there are time-based charge rules, the rate is determined by the applied charge rule. Any rates entered on time records are discarded. If you are entering time for a payroll item like vacation time, leave this field blank.
overrideRate.title: Lock this Rate

rate.description: If you selected a price in the Price Level field, it automatically appears here. If you don't use multiple prices or if you selected Custom in the Price Level field, enter a rate for this time transaction. If you're entering time for a payroll item like vacation time, leave this field blank. If you're entering time for a charge-based project and there are time-based charge rules, any rate entered in this field will be overridden by the applied charge rule.
rate.title: Rate

tranDate.description: NetSuite inserts today's date as the date of this transaction. You can type or pick another date.
tranDate.title: Date

startDate.description: NetSuite displays the start date for the current timesheet.

subsidiary.description: The subsidiary associated with the employee is displayed here.
subsidiary.title: Subsidiary

totalHours.description: NetSuite displays the total hours entered on this timesheet. This field is updated in real time.
totalHours.title: Total Hours

tranDate.description: NetSuite inserts today's date as the date of this transaction. You can type or pick another date.
tranDate.title: Week Of

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

description.description: Enter a description of this topic. This description shows in the topic list and also where it is published. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
description.title: Brief Description

isInactive.description: Check this box if you no longer want to use this record. Inactivating records removes them from lists and references everywhere in your account, but they are still available by clicking the Show Inactives box on lists.
isInactive.title: Inactive

longDescription.description: Enter the text of this solution or topic here. You can use Javascript, HTML and CRMDSK tags in this description. Click Preview to see how this solution will appear when published. If you see the Enhance text button next to this field, you can get writing help for this field from our generative AI service, NetSuite Text Enhance. Click the Enhance Text button to use the available options. Learn more about Text Enhance.
longDescription.title: Detailed Description

title.description: Enter a title for this solution. Because solution titles can be searched, this title should be relative to the solution subject. This title shows on the Solutions subtab of the case and topic records that this solution is applied to and in published knowledge bases.
title.title: Title

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.

firmed.description: When the Firmed box is checked, the line items are no longer eligible for reallocation to another order. The items must remain committed to the firmed order. Firmed transfer orders are not available to be rescheduled or cancelled.
firmed.title: Firmed

memo.description: Enter a memo to identify this transfer order. When you use the Search Transactions feature, you can search for specific words and phrases in the Memo field.
memo.title: Memo

shipAddress.description: The Ship To Address of the transfer order defaults to the address of the destination location. To enter a different address: * Select another address in the Ship To Select field. * Select New in the Ship To Select field to enter a new billing address.
shipAddress.title: Ship To

shipComplete.description: Check this box if you want to ship this order when there are enough items available to fully fulfill the orders. When fulfilling orders in bulk, you can filter the list to include those orders marked Ship Complete that can be completely fulfilled by selecting Respect Ship Complete in the Filter By field.
shipComplete.title: Ship Complete

shipDate.description: The date defaults to show the current date. You can type or pick another shipping date for this order.
shipDate.title: Ship Date

subtotal.description: As you add items, the total shows in this field.
subtotal.title: Subtotal

total.description: This field shows the total amount associated with this order, including shipping and handling costs.
total.title: Total

trackingNumbers.description: This field displays the tracking number provided by the carrier for the shipment.
trackingNumbers.title: Tracking Numbers

tranDate.description: The current date autofills for this transfer order. You can select or enter a different date.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: Enter the number of this transfer order. If you use autogenerated numbering, the next order number in the sequence shows here. You can enter another number if you choose.
tranId.title: Transaction Number

addr1.description: Enter the address the way it should appear on forms. For employees, customers, partners, and vendors, what you enter here autofills on forms if this address is marked default for Shipping or Billing. Enter up to 50 characters. This field is required for the Online Bill Pay feature.
addr1.title: Address 1

addr2.description: Enter an optional second address line the way it should appear on forms. For employees, customers, partners, and vendors, what you enter here autofills on forms if this address is marked default for Shipping or Billing. Enter up to 50 characters.
addr2.title: Address 2

addrText.description: The values entered in the other address fields are displayed here.
addrText.title: Address

addressee.description: Enter the name of the entity that should appear on the shipping label here. This name appears on the shipping label below what you enter in the Attention field.
addressee.title: Addressee

attention.description: Enter the name of the person to whom a shipment is addressed, as it should appear on shipping labels. This field is required for UPS Integration.
attention.title: Attention

city.description: Enter the city the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
city.title: Town

override.description: Check this box to disable the free-form address text field. When this field is disabled, text entered in the other address fields does not display in the Address text field. Clear this box to allow text entered in the address component fields to appear in the free-form address text field.
override.title: Override

state.description: Enter your company's state or province the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
state.title: State/Province

zip.description: Enter the postal code the way it should appear on all forms except checks.
zip.title: Zip

isInactive.description: Check this box to inactivate this unit record. When a record is inactive, it does not appear in lists and cannot be selected on records and transactions.
isInactive.title: Inactive

name.description: Enter a name for the type of units you are creating. For example, enter "Length" to create units of Inch, Foot and Yard.
name.title: Type Name

accountNumber.description: If your vendors assign account numbers to you, enter one here. This number will later appear in these places: * In the Vendor # field on purchase orders * In the Memo field on checks
accountNumber.title: Account Number

altPhone.description: Enter an optional alternate phone number for this record. Phone numbers can be entered in the following formats:999-999-9999, 1-999-999-9999, (999) 999-9999, 1(999) 999-9999 or 999-999-9999 ext 9999 .
altPhone.title: Alt. Phone

autoName.description: Clear this box to manually enter a name for this record. If you leave this box marked, NetSuite assigns a name or number for this record based on your settings at Setup > Company > Auto-Generated Numbers.
autoName.title: Auto

balance.description: The vendor's current accounts payable balance due appears here.
balance.title: Balance (Base)

balancePrimary.description: This is a read-only calculated field that returns the vendor's current accounts payable balance in the specified currency.
balancePrimary.title: Balance

comments.description: Enter any other information you wish to track for this vendor.
comments.title: Comments

companyName.description: In the Company name field, enter the supplier's legal name. If you use Auto-Generated Numbering, you should enter the vendor name here to ensure that it appears along with the code in lists.
companyName.title: Company Name

creditLimit.description: Enter an optional credit limit for your purchases from this vendor. If you have a NetSuite OneWorld account, enter the global credit limit for this vendor and any assigned subsidiary. This value can exceed the sum of the vendor and subsidiary credit limits. This credit limit sets a maximum currency amount that should be spent using credit without making a payment. The value displays in the vendor’s primary currency. The default is no value, or no credit limit. You can place the vendor on hold by entering 0 (zero.) Any new purchase order or vendor bill transaction displays a warning message. You cannot enter a negative value. NetSuite validates the transaction amounts on purchase orders and vendor bills against the global credit limit specified in the Credit Limit field. NetSuite does not include individual subsidiary credit limits in the global credit limit validation.
creditLimit.title: Credit Limit

dateCreated.description: The date this record was created displays here.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

defaultAddress.description: This field automatically shows the default billing address that you enter and add using the Address subtab.
defaultAddress.title: Default Address

defaultShippingAddress.description: Returns the vendor's default shipping address, if one is entered on the vendor record.
defaultShippingAddress.title: Default Shipping Address

email.description: Enter the e-mail address of your vendor. If you allow your vendors online access, this becomes part of their access code.
email.title: Vendor Email

emailTransactions.description: Set a preferred transaction delivery method for this vendor. Choose to send transactions by regular mail, by email, by fax, or by a combination of the three. Then, when you select the vendor on a transaction, their preferred delivery method is marked by default. * Email – Check this box to check the To Be Emailed box by default on transactions when this vendor is selected. * Print – Check this box to check the To Be Printed box by default on transactions when this vendor is selected. * Fax – Check this box to check the To Be Faxed box by default on transactions when this vendor is selected. Once you enter these settings on the vendor record, these boxes are checked by default for transactions created from the vendor record or for transactions that are copied or converted. Note: These settings override any customized settings on transaction forms you use. There are also preferences to set default values for new vendor records at Setup > Company > Printing, Fax and Email Preferences. On the Print subtab, Fax subtab, or Email subtab, check Vendors Default to [Print/Fax/Email] Transactions. You can also set these fields using the Mass Update function. Go to Lists > Mass Update > Mass Updates > General and click Vendor.
emailTransactions.title: Email Transactions

entityId.description: Enter your vendor's name here the way it should appear in all lists. If you use Auto-Generated Numbering, this field fills with the vendor number or code.
entityId.title: Entity ID
