chromaSubsampling.description: Check this box to apply chroma subsampling to the images. Chroma subsampling reduces the color information in favor of luminance data and results in image files that look the same but are smaller in size.
chromaSubsampling.title: Chroma Subsampling

compressedImageQuality.description: Select the quality level you want the compressed images to have: * Low (maximum compression) - minor reduction in quality * Standard - minor reduction in quality when images are zoomed * Optimum (recommended) – occasional minor reduction in quality when images are zoomed * Very High (minimum compression) - no noticeable reduction in quality at any time
compressedImageQuality.title: Compressed Image Quality

confPageTrackingHtml.description: Enter any tracking HTML you want to use in the header of the order confirmation page. This allows you to track the number of order you receive a day, for example.
confPageTrackingHtml.title: Order Tracking Script HTML

createCustomersAsCompanies.description: Check this box to have all customers who register in your site created as Company type. You must also check the Mandatory box to have customers created as companies. Clear this box to have all customers created as Individuals. Customers created as individuals can also be saved as contacts and have a first and last name saved on record with an optional Company field. Customers created as companies have a Contacts subtab for individuals in the company and a mandatory Company field.
createCustomersAsCompanies.title: Create Customers as Companies

descriptionFontSize.description: Enter the font size you want to use for item and category descriptions in your Web site.
descriptionFontSize.title: Description Font Size

dispFirstLastnameSeparately.description: Check this box to display separate fields for first and last name on the registration page. When this box is cleared, one field appears in which customers can enter their names. Note: Even when one Name field is displayed, both first and last names are required. Note also that this check box only affects Site Builder websites where the My Account extension is not applied.
dispFirstLastnameSeparately.title: Display First and Last Name in Separate Fields on Registration Page

displayCompanyField.description: Check this box to let customers enter a company name during the checkout process.
displayCompanyField.title: Display Company Field on Registration Page

displayName.description: This is the name for your site that displays in the heading of your Web store and in customers' browser windows.
displayName.title: Display Name

doctypeHtml.description: Enter the code for the document type declaration of your Web site. This tells the browser the type of code you are using in your site. For example, if you are using HTML5, the document type declaration is: <!DOCTYPE html>
doctypeHtml.title: Document Type

enableGAIntegration.description: Check this box to pass Google tracking cookies from shopping to checkout. This along with the fields on the Analytics subtab are required for cross-domain analytics tracking to integrate NetSuite with your Google Analytics account. Clear this box if Google Analytics Integration interferes with a custom solution you have already implemented for cross-domain tracking.
enableGAIntegration.title: Enable Google Analytics Integration

hidePaymentPageWhenNoBalance.description: Check this box to hide the payment page in the checkout process if the order is equal to zero. Some e-commerce sites offer promotional products for free. This preference allows web customers to put a promotional item in the cart, and complete checkout without being required to input payment information.
hidePaymentPageWhenNoBalance.title: Hide Payment Page If Order Total Equals Zero

includeUncategorizedItems.description: Check this box to display items in search results that have the Display in Web Site box checked, even if they are not published in your Web site. This can be useful if you have not categorized an item that is for sale. Clear this box to only allow search results to return items published on tabs and categories in your site.
includeUncategorizedItems.title: Show Uncategorized Items

includeVatWithPrices.description: For UK accounts, check this box to include VAT in the item prices on lists and descriptions in your site as follows: £100.00 (Incl. VAT).
includeVatWithPrices.title: Prices Include Tax

internalName.description: This is the name for your site that displays on lists in your NetSuite account. This name is not exposed to external customers.
internalName.title: Internal Name

isInactive.description: Check the Inactive box if you want to make a website inaccessible to users but you do not want to delete it permanently. An inactive site still retains internal references to other areas of NetSuite. For more information, see Making a Website Inactive.
isInactive.title: Inactive

isScriptableCartAndCheckout.description: Check this box to run SuiteScript on the sales order form submitted during the web store checkout. To use scriptable checkout, you must customize a Standard Online Order form by adding your script to the transaction form. Check this box to activate your script during Web store checkout. Note: If you use terms for your customers, you must attach your checkout script to both a customized Online Order - Invoice form, and an Online Order - Cash Sales form.
isScriptableCartAndCheckout.title: Scriptable Cart and Checkout

isWebstoreOffline.description: Check this box to temporarily take your store or site offline for maintenance. When you have finished making changes, clear this check box and your store or site will be available for shoppers.
isWebstoreOffline.title: Take Website Offline for Maintenance

legacyImageAttributeTags.description: If this box is checked, tags that access any image attribute (image, thumbnail, or image custom field) return the file name. If this box is cleared, the URL the image is hosted from is returned. Clearing this box is preferred. By providing you with the complete URL, you can use the tag to construct embedded images or links to popup windows.
legacyImageAttributeTags.title: Legacy Tag Support for Images

nonCcPayMethodsAllowed.description: Check this box to display custom payment methods that you create as alternatives to credit card payment methods. If you use Site Builder, checking this box will automatically display the payment method on the Payment Information page in the checkout process. If you operate a SuiteCommerce Advanced web site, a web developer can use the Commerce API to store the payment method selected on the web order. Additional customization is required. For more information, visit the Help Center, and read Creating an Alternative to Credit Card Payment Methods for Web Store Orders.
nonCcPayMethodsAllowed.title: Allow non-credit card payment methods during Checkout

outputLineBreaksAsBr.description: Check this box to covert any line break in descriptions fields for items, tabs or categories you've created in NetSuite to the BR tag.
outputLineBreaksAsBr.title: Output Line Breaks as <br>

passPromoCodeToCheckout.description: Check this box to automatically apply promotion codes passed through a link to items added to the shopping cart. When a shopper clicks a link with an appended promotion code that has an associated discount, the shopper will see the discount itemized and reflected in the order total on the last page of checkout. Create promotion codes at Commerce > Marketing > Promotions > New. Append codes for promo codes to URL links using &promocode=[promotioncode]. For example, you can append the promo code for the fall clearance sale on t-shirts, http://shop.mywebsite.com/tshirts&promocode=FALLSALE. LIST_REFERRALCODE_COMMERCE
passPromoCodeToCheckout.title: Pass URL Promotion Code to Checkout

relatedItemsDescription.description: Enter a brief description of the list of Related Items, that you set up in NetSuite. A list of related items will show on the item details page. For example, you can enter “If you like these items, you may also like:”
relatedItemsDescription.title: Related Items Description

requestShippingAddressFirst.description: Check this box to ask for customers' shipping addresses before their billing addresses during the Web store checkout process.
requestShippingAddressFirst.title: Ask For Shipping Address First

requireCompanyField.description: If you checked the field named Display Company Field on Registration Page, then check this box to make the Company field mandatory. Clear this box to make this field optional. You must check this box to create customer records of company type.
requireCompanyField.title: Mandatory Company Field on Registration Page

requireShippingInformation.description: Check this box to require shipping information to be entered before checking out of your Web store.
requireShippingInformation.title: Shipping Information is Required

requireTermsAndConditions.description: Check this box to have customers to agree to the terms of the product or service they are buying before checking out of your store. This places an “I Agree” checkbox that customers must check to show that they agree to your terms. They can view the full terms and conditions by clicking a link that opens a popup window. If you use the Advanced Site Customization feature, you can customize the name of this checkbox at Commerce > Content Management > Customize Text or Commerce > Site Builder > Customize Text.
requireTermsAndConditions.title: Require Terms and Conditions

sEmailAddrForError.description: If you opt to receive checkout error email, enter the email address where you would like to receive the error alerts.
sEmailAddrForError.title: Send email of Checkout errors to address

sFromCheckoutErrorEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromCheckoutErrorEmail.title: Send email of Checkout errors from address

sFromDownloadAvailableEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromDownloadAvailableEmail.title: Download availability email sent from address

sFromGiftCertificateConfEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromGiftCertificateConfEmail.title: Gift Certificate Confirmation sent from email address

sFromGiftCertificateEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromGiftCertificateEmail.title: Gift Certificate sent from email address

sFromLicenseCodeEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromLicenseCodeEmail.title: Send License Code email from this address

sFromOrderApprovedConfEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromOrderApprovedConfEmail.title: Order approval email sent from address

sFromOrderCancelledConfEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromOrderCancelledConfEmail.title: Canceled order email sent from address

sFromOrderFulfilledConfEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromOrderFulfilledConfEmail.title: Order fulfillment email sent from address

sFromOrderReceivedConfEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to web store customers. If you operate multiple web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromOrderReceivedConfEmail.title: Order received email sent from address

sFromPasswordRecoveryEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromPasswordRecoveryEmail.title: Send Password Recovery email from this address

sFromRegistrationConfEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email messages are sent to Web store customers. If you operate multiple Web sites, you can enter a different address for each site.
sFromRegistrationConfEmail.title: Registration Confirmation email sent from address

sRegistrationConfEmailCopy.description: If you checked the BCC Confirmation Email box, enter the email address here that you want to receive web store registration confirmation email. You can enter more than one address separated by a comma.
sRegistrationConfEmailCopy.title: BCC Registration Confirmation Recipient Emails

sStoreEmailAddrForCopy.description: If you checked the BCC Confirmation Email box, enter the email address here that you want to receive store order confirmation email. You can enter more than one address separated by a comma.
sStoreEmailAddrForCopy.title: BCC Order Received Recipient Emails

sStoreEmailAddrForGiftConfCopy.title: BCC Gift Certificate Confirmation Recipient Emails

sStoreEmailAddrForGiftCopy.description: If you checked the BCC Order Received Email box or the BCC Gift Certificate Emails box, enter the email address where you want to send copies of the message. You can enter more than one address separated by a comma.
sStoreEmailAddrForGiftCopy.title: BCC Gift Certificate Recipient Emails

saveCreditInfo.description: Check this box to save customer credit card information by default. If you check the Display Save My Credit Card Infor Field box, customers can still opt to clear this box in your site if they do not want card information saved. Note: If you have website customers that are companies with multiple contacts, do not check this box. A contact is a company-owned entity. A credit card created by a contact will be available to other contacts associated with that company.
saveCreditInfo.title: Save Credit Card Info by Default

searchForCategories.description: Check the Show Categories in Search Results box to include relevant categories in search results. Clearing this box returns only relevant items.
searchForCategories.title: Include Categories in Search Results

searchForInformationItems.description: Check the Show Information Items in Search Results check box to include items of type Information Item in the search results when a global search is performed in the web store. If this box is unchecked, then, items of this type will not be included/displayed in the search results.
searchForInformationItems.title: Include Information Items in Search Results

shipsToAllCountries.description: Check this box to allow orders placed in the Web store to be shipped to any country. Clear this box to limit the countries you ship to using the Countries Web Store ships to field.
shipsToAllCountries.title: Website Ships to All Countries

showCartSummaryPortlet.description: Check this box to include the Shopping Cart portlet in your Web site.This portlet shows what customers currently have in their shopping carts.
showCartSummaryPortlet.title: Show Cart Summary

showCookieConsentBanner.description: Check this box to publish a banner requesting that shoppers comply with the use of cookies on your site.
showCookieConsentBanner.title: Show Cookie Consent Banner

showCurrencyPortlet.description: Check this box to allow web site customers to choose a currency for shopping in your store. When you check this box, an online shopper can select a currency on your site's Home page. After a currency is selected, all item prices will appear in the selected currency. For more information, visit SuiteAnswers, and read the topic, Multiple Currencies in the Web Store.
showCurrencyPortlet.title: Show Website Currency

showExtendedCart.description: The extended cart allows shoppers to add the following information on the shopping cart page: * Coupon code * Gift certificate * Shipping information To display additional fields for entering shipping information, you must enable both preferences, Show Shipping Estimator in Cart and Show Extended Cart.
showExtendedCart.title: Show Extended Cart

showNavigationPortlet.description: Check this box to include the Item Navigation portlet in your site. This portlet appears on the left side of your site and lets customers navigate between items and categories. You can set preferences for this portlet on site themes if you use the Advanced Site Customization feature.
showNavigationPortlet.title: Show Navigation Portlet

showPOFieldOnPayment.description: Check this box to show a text field on the Payment Information page of your store where customers can enter Purchase Order numbers. The Purchase Order number entered will automatically appear on sales orders generated from your Web store.
showPOFieldOnPayment.title: Display Purchase Order Field on Payment Info Page

showSaveCreditInfo.description: Check this box to allow customers to save their credit card information wth their login for use the next time they shop with you. When customers opt to save credit card info during checkout, the credit card info is stored on the customer record and available as a payment choice the next time they check out. Note: If you have website customers that are companies with multiple contacts, do not check this box. A contact is a company-owned entity. A credit card created by a contact will be available to other contacts associated with that company.
showSaveCreditInfo.title: Display 'Save My Credit Card Info' Field

showSearchPortlet.description: Check this box to display the Search portlet in your Web site. Customers can use this system-generated search entry field to search for products or information on your site.
showSearchPortlet.title: Show Search

showShippingEstimator.description: * In Site Builder websites, check this box to give customers an estimate of shipping costs before they complete shipping information in checkout. The lowest estimated shipping cost is displayed by default. If you offer real-time rates, a customer can enter a zip code to receive an estimate. If the order qualifies for free shipping, “Free Shipping” is displayed. * In SuiteCommerce Advanced websites, you can check this box if you do not have a default Shipping Method chosen. The Shipping Estimator shows the lowest shipping cost from available Shipping Methods.
showShippingEstimator.title: Show Shipping Estimator in Cart

showTellAFriendLink.description: Checking this box adds a “Tell A Friend” link to the detailed description page for each item published to your site. When a shopper on your site clicks the Tell a Friend link, an email editor opens up. The subject of the email message is “Hi There,” by default. The content includes the text, “I thought you would like to have a look at this product at,” followed by a link to the item on your site. You can customize the text in the email message by going to > > Content > Customize Text.
showTellAFriendLink.title: Show "Tell a Friend" Link

storeEmail.description: Enter the email address that should show in the From field when email notification and confirmation is sent to Web site customers. This field is optional. Note: This address is only used if you leave the Email From Address field blank on any of the email template subtabs.
storeEmail.title: Default Website Email From Address

stripMetadata.description: Check this box to remove all metadata (such as camera details, caption, copyright information) from the images.
stripMetadata.title: Strip metadata

termsAndConditionsHtml.description: Enter HTML code for the terms and conditions text that should be available from your Web site. Customers can click a link to view this text in a popup window before agreeing to the terms.
termsAndConditionsHtml.title: Terms and Conditions HTML

titleFontSize.description: Enter the font size you want to use for item and category titles in your Web site.
titleFontSize.title: Title Font Size

upsellDescription.description: Enter a brief description of the upsell correlated items list to show above the list of recommended items in your site. For example, you can enter “Customers Who Bought This Item Also Bought:”
upsellDescription.title: Upsell Description

upsellMinimumCorrelation.description: Enter the minimum correlation percentage an item should have to the item being viewed or items in the cart. Correlation percentage measures how often items are purchased together.
upsellMinimumCorrelation.title: Minimum Correlation % for Upsell

upsellMinimumCount.description: Only items with a greater count than what you set here are displayed. Count represents the number of customers that have purchased both the items being viewed or in the cart and the upsell item recommendations.
upsellMinimumCount.title: Minimum Number of Buyers for Upsell

upsellMinimumLift.description: Only items with greater lift than what you set here are displayed. Lift is the degree to which the item's correlation exceeds its overall purchase frequency. A high lift implies a more reliable correlation.
upsellMinimumLift.title: Minimum Lift % for Upsell

websiteLogoLinkUrl.description: Enter the URL you want to use as a hyperlink when site visitors click your logo. If you don't want to create a hyperlink for your logo, leave this field blank.
websiteLogoLinkUrl.title: Logo Link URL

webstoreMetaTags.description: Enter data for the header in this field. You can enter a script to capture web analytics. For information, see the Web Analytics Tools Preferences help topic. In this field, you can also add Meta Tag HTML to appear in the < head > section of all your Web store pages. Note that Meta tags entered on Category and Tab pages are more effective for the purpose of search engine optimization (SEO).
webstoreMetaTags.title: Addition to <head>

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

expandAssembly.description: Check the Mark Sub-Assemblies Phantom box to build member items that are also assemblies used to complete the work order. Sub-assembly components are displayed on the Items subtab. To learn more, see Work Orders and Sub-Assemblies
expandAssembly.title: Mark Sub-assemblies Phantom

firmed.description: Planned work order status is displayed as either Open or Firmed. 1. Firmed planned work orders are not deleted before supply planning runs. Check this box to firm the order. 2. Open planned work orders are deleted before supply planning runs. Clear this box to keep the order open.
firmed.title: Firmed

memo.description: Optionally, enter a Memo for this work order. You can search for the memo text to find this work order.
memo.title: Memo

quantity.description: Enter the Quantity of assembly items you want to create. This can be a fractional number.
quantity.title: Quantity

tranDate.description: NetSuite displays today's Date as the default work order date. You can enter or select another date.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: NetSuite automatically increases the largest work Order # (number) by one. You can enter another number, however the next order number will revert to the standard pattern.
tranId.title: Order No.

units.description: The Units field displays the units of the component used in the parent assembly.
units.title: Unit of Measure

memo.description: Memo displays any text accompanying this work order. You can search for text entered here to find the transaction later.
memo.title: Memo

orderQuantity.description: Work Order Quantity identifies the number of items built using this work order.
orderQuantity.title: Work Order Quantity

quantity.description: The number of items, Quantity Built using this work order.
quantity.title: Quantity

tranDate.description: The Date that this work order was closed.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: The work order issue Reference # (number).
tranId.title: Ref No.

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

items.description: An array field that represents a collection of elements, for example, sublist lines, multiselect items, or search results.
items.title: Items

memo.description: Optionally enter a memo for this transaction. You can search for text entered here to find the transaction later.
memo.title: Memo

orderQuantity.description: The quantity of assemblies from the work order displays in this field.
orderQuantity.title: Work Order Quantity

quantity.description: Enter the number of assemblies to record as being completed.
quantity.title: Quantity

total.description: Unlike on an assembly build, the Projected Value field on a work order completion displays the cost of the assembly, not individual components (unless you use backflush.)
total.title: Projected Value

tranDate.description: Select or verify the date for this transaction. The current date autofills this field.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: In the Reference # field, you can enter a reference number to track this transaction.
tranId.title: Ref No.

units.description: The unit of measure for this item is displayed in this field.
units.title: Unit of Measure

items.title: Items

memo.title: Memo

tranDate.description: Select or verify the date for this transaction. The current date autofills this field.
tranDate.title: Date

tranId.description: In the Reference # field, you can enter a reference number to track this transaction.
tranId.title: Ref No.
